sources.название: Classification of chronic pain and spinal cord stimulation response using machine learning in magnetoencephalography data
sources.авторы: Bart Witjes; Martijn P. A. Starmans; Frank J.P.M. Huygen; Cecile C. de Vos
sources.модальность: Resting-state MEG spectral features from 94 atlas regions
sources.задача: Chronic-pain classification and exploratory association with concurrent SCS-session outcomes
sources.метод: WORC ensemble with leave-one-participant-out evaluation and nested 5x random-split model selection
sources.датасет: 25 SCS patients, 25 chronic-pain patients, and 25 pain-free controls; SCS group measured after tonic, burst, and sham weeks
sources.производительность: Chronic-pain versus control accuracy 76%; theta AUC 0.80; SCS-group classifier score versus NRS Spearman rho 0.12
sources.кросс_субъект: yes: leave-one-participant-out cross-validation
sources.ограничения: MEG classification separates chronic-pain patients from pain-free controls and its scores correlate poorly with pain ratings in the SCS group (rho=0.12). There was no pre-implant baseline in the SCS group and no prospective SCS-responder classifier. MEG spectral features are not ECAP.

sources.название: Explainable AI for pain perception: subject-independent EEG decoding using DeepSHAP and CNNs
sources.авторы: Feyzi Alkım Aktaş; Aykut Eken; Osman Eroğul
sources.модальность: Laser-evoked 65-channel EEG; parietal 20-frequency by 251-time-point masked time-frequency matrices after preprocessing
sources.задача: Classify individually calibrated low versus high acute laser-stimulus intensity in healthy adults during the motor condition
sources.метод: Five-layer 1D-CNN and DeepSHAP compared with SVM, LDA, KNN, RF and decision tree under participant LOSO. A label-informed cluster-permutation mask was computed on the complete cohort before the LOSO folds; z-score normalization was fitted within training folds.
sources.датасет: Secondary analysis of Tiemann et al. 2018 Nature Communications 9:4487, DOI 10.1038/s41467-018-06875-x: motor-condition EEG from 50 of the source study's 51 healthy right-handed adults; low/high laser stimuli, 20 planned trials per intensity and participant.
sources.производительность: Authors report mean participant-LOSO accuracy 95.85% +/- 5% on the selected 50-person cohort. Results section also reports 231 high and 152 low correct plus 9 and 8 errors over 400 test trials; that pooled confusion count gives 383/400 = 95.75%. The paper does not reconcile 400 reported test trials with its 50-person by 40-trial SHAP description.
sources.кросс_субъект: Participant LOSO across 50 people, but label-informed feature-mask selection used the entire cohort before folds; the authors explicitly acknowledge possible optimistic bias.
sources.ограничения: The label-informed permutation mask was selected using all subjects, including held-out subjects, before LOSO; authors acknowledge possible optimistic bias despite train-only z-scoring. The 400-trial confusion denominator is not reconciled with the 50 by 40 trial description, and its pooled accuracy differs from the reported mean. No independent external dataset, chronic clinical pain, ECAP or SCS outcome was tested. SHAP attribution is not a causal biomarker.

evidence.population: 50 healthy right-handed adults in the motor-condition EEG subset of Tiemann et al. 2018

validation.notes: Publisher version-of-record PDF (13 pages) was read through r.jina.ai text rendering because direct IOP requests returned a Radware CAPTCHA; primary source is the IOP PDF URL. Section 2.4 explicitly says a supervised permutation mask used the complete dataset before participant LOSO and acknowledges optimistic bias. Training-fold z-scoring does not remove this feature-selection leakage. Sections 3.2-3.3 give 400 test trials and a 50 x 40 trial SHAP matrix without a reconciliation. The original dataset is Tiemann et al. 2018 motor-condition EEG, not a new patient cohort.

Chapter 2 overlaps preprint S029 and is not independent replication. Behavioral aversion and neural response do not establish subjective pain; no human ECAP/SCS transfer tested.

sources.название: Real-Time Pain Assessment from Electrodermal Activity Using Deep Learning
sources.авторы: Calvin Joseph; Maryam Ghahramani; Raul Fernandez Rojas
sources.модальность: Electrodermal activity at 100 Hz
sources.задача: Three-class experimentally induced pain-intensity recognition and real-time deployment
sources.метод: Fully convolutional network with strict subject-wise five-fold cross-validation
sources.датасет: AI4Pain: 65 healthy participants; independent real-time GUI cohort of 15 unseen participants
sources.производительность: 79.23% offline accuracy; 73.14% real-time accuracy; 0.47 ms FCN inference latency
sources.кросс_субъект: yes: subject-wise five-fold split; independent 15-participant real-time cohort
sources.ограничения: Controlled TENS-evoked experimental pain in healthy participants; EDA reflects autonomic response and does not establish chronic-pain, ECAP, or SCS-outcome validity.

provenance.query_or_seed: Real-Time Pain Assessment from Electrodermal Activity Using Deep Learning

evidence.population: 65 healthy participants plus 15 unseen healthy participants
evidence.sample_size: 65 AI4Pain participants in subject-wise five-fold evaluation; separate 15 previously unseen participants in same-protocol GUI evaluation (not one pooled evaluation cohort).
evidence.target_label: No Pain, Low Pain, High Pain

validation.notes: Controlled TENS-evoked experimental pain in healthy participants; EDA reflects autonomic response and does not establish chronic-pain, ECAP, or SCS-outcome validity. Rechecked 2026-09-28: GUI group is unseen but uses the same laboratory protocol and sensors, so it is a participant holdout rather than external site/dataset validation. Results: 0.47 ms Table 7, 79.23% Table 9, 73.14% Table 10/Results 3.4. Article Methods 2.1 prose says 65 no-pain instances while Table 1 reports 715 no-pain observations; this internal discrepancy is not resolved.

sources.авторы: Xiao-Min Lin; Xiao-Shuo Zhang; Hang Zhou; Xiu-Yi Han; Zhao-Xing Wei; Tor D. Wager; Irene Tracey; Ji-Xin Liu; Cun-Zhi Liu; Ya-Zhuo Kong
sources.модальность: Кортикоспинальная
sources.задача: Predict human self-reported experimental pain intensity from corticospinal fMRI; assess specificity and bounded application to one chronic-pain IBS cohort.
sources.метод: Corticospinal Pain Intensity Pattern (CsPIP): simultaneous brain/cervical-cord fMRI with multivariate LASSO-PCR; predictive coding is a Discussion interpretation, not the fitting algorithm.
sources.ограничения: The study applies CsPIP to independent experimental and one IBS chronic-pain cohort, but TENS sensitivity is assessed in a subset of the discovery study whose baseline data contributed to model development. The treated-side TENS association is r=0.36, p=0.049, not an independent TENS validation. No ECAP, SCS response or clinical treatment-efficacy inference follows.

sources.название: Machine learning predicts spinal cord stimulation surgery outcomes and reveals novel neural markers for chronic pain
sources.авторы: Jay Gopal; Jonathan Bao; Tessa Harland; Julie G. Pilitsis; Steven Paniccioli; Rachael Grey; Michael Briotte; Kevin McCarthy; Ilknur Telkes
sources.метод: Intraoperative EEG spectral features plus clinical features and preoperative PROMs; PCA/RFE feature selection, decision-tree model, leave-one-patient-out evaluation
sources.датасет: 20 SCS surgery patients recruited; 17 analyzed after excluding three without postoperative NRS; seven responders and ten nonresponders
sources.ограничения: The model predicts at least 50% reduction in 3-month postoperative NRS, using intraoperative EEG, clinical variables and preoperative PROMs. Feature selection, hyperparameter/seed search and feature-count optimization are described before or across LOOCV, so the reported 88.2% accuracy and 0.879 AUROC may be optimistically biased. No independent external test and no ECAP input.

sources.название: Prediction of Response to Spinal Cord Stimulation Using Machine Learning Based on Radiomics and Patient-Reported Outcomes
sources.авторы: Eung-Joo Lee; Meghan L. Edgerton; Barbara Buccilli; Ilknur Telkes; Tessa Harland; Julie G. Pilitsis
sources.модальность: Spinal imaging radiomics, clinical variables and patient-reported outcomes
sources.задача: Prediction of 50% and 70% SCS responder targets
sources.метод: Single-clinic prospective SCS cohort; preoperative clinical, patient-reported and MRI radiomic variables linked to one-year NRS response. Models use KNN imputation and MinMax scaling, an 80/20 train_test_split, five stratified GridSearchCV folds and RFE feature selection. sources.название: GIAFormer: A Gradient-Infused Attention and Transformer for Pain Assessment with EDA-fNIRS Fusion
sources.авторы: Muhammad Umar Khan; Girija Chetty; Stefanos Gkikas; Manolis Tsiknakis; Roland Goecke; Raul Fernandez-Rojas
sources.задача: Three-class acute experimental pain-intensity classification (No Pain, Low Pain, High Pain) from EDA and fNIRS in healthy AI4Pain participants.
sources.метод: GIAFormer fuses EDA and fNIRS using gradient-infused attention and a Transformer. Performance evaluation uses leave-one-subject-out validation: one participant is held out per fold and fold metrics are averaged.
sources.датасет: AI4Pain: 65 healthy participants (42 male, 23 female), aged 17-52; 2,340 non-overlapping 10-second EDA/fNIRS observations, 36 segments per person and 780 per class. These segments are repeated observations, not independent participants.
sources.производительность: Author-reported Table 3 metric/dispersion pairs: accuracy 90.51% +/- 9.33, F1 90.38% +/- 9.65, specificity 95.26% +/- 4.66; class TPRs 94.36% +/- 8.35 (No Pain), 88.97% +/- 15.46 (Low Pain), 88.21% +/- 13.49 (High Pain). Figure 6 caption labels plotted metric dispersion as standard deviations, but Table 3 does not define the statistic or calculation unit for its listed dispersion; do not interpret these values as SD across LOSOV folds.
sources.кросс_субъект: Yes: leave-one-subject-out across the 65 AI4Pain participants; each participant is the test set once. No independent external cohort was tested.
sources.ограничения: Full publisher PDF body recovered from embedded page objects in a publisher-served artifact (SHA-256 8474bc90b239dcfcf970338cde2ff62629699e9aa0782e04c89ba661eb16a7dd); the active PDF page tree exposes only page 1. Results concern controlled acute experimental stimuli in 65 healthy people and 2,340 repeated segments. Table 3 reports metric/dispersion pairs; Figure 6 labels plotted metric dispersion as standard deviations, but Table 3 does not define the statistic or calculation unit for its values. LOSOV performance is participant-held-out within this cohort. No independent external cohort or probability calibration is reported. Dataset access is on reasonable request; the cited code repository did not expose the trained code/models in this check. This study does not validate chronic pain, ECAP, SCS treatment response or clinical deployment.

provenance.query_or_seed: GIAFormer: A Gradient-Infused Attention and Transformer for Pain Assessment with EDA-fNIRS Fusion

evidence.population: 65 healthy human volunteers (42 male, 23 female), age 17-52, mean age 29.06 +/- 8.28 years; AI4Pain acute controlled stimulation.
evidence.target_label: No Pain (L0), Low Pain (L1, individual QST threshold) and High Pain (L2, individual QST tolerance), based on controlled electrical stimulation; not a common clinical NRS endpoint.

validation.notes: Publisher-served PDF checked 2026-09-27, 7,464,349 bytes, SHA-256 8474bc90b239dcfcf970338cde2ff62629699e9aa0782e04c89ba661eb16a7dd. Its active tree exposes only the first page; the recovered embedded page objects contain the 16-page article. Section 3.4 reports participant-held-out LOSOV and says iteration metrics were averaged. Table 3 (p. 9) lists author-reported metric/dispersion pairs, including accuracy 90.51% +/- 9.33, F1 90.38% +/- 9.65, and specificity 95.26% +/- 4.66; it does not define the dispersion statistic or calculation unit. Figure 6 caption (p. 8) labels plotted metric dispersion as standard deviations, without specifying that Table 3 values are SD across LOSOV folds. No predictive uncertainty or confidence intervals are established. No external cohort or calibration is reported; data are request-only. No chronic-pain, ECAP or SCS outcome conclusion.

sources.название: External validation of EEG-based machine learning models for continuous pain prediction
sources.авторы: Tyler Mari; Jessica Henderson; Syed Hasan Ali; Danielle Hewitt; Christopher Brown; Andrej Stancak; Nicholas Fallon
sources.модальность: EEG
sources.задача: Continuous experimental pain-rating prediction and low/high trial classification
sources.метод: Random Forest and LSTM regression on single-trial EEG time-frequency features; RF low/high classifier
sources.датасет: 91 distinct participants: sample 1 n=40 for model development, sample 2 n=51 for cross-subject external validation; sample 3 n=25 consists of additional sessions from sample-1 participants, not 25 additional people.
sources.производительность: Experimental pneumatic-pressure pain ratings: RF continuous-prediction MAE 19.59 internal, 21.29 cross-subject external and 18.90 within-subject temporal external; neither regression model beat a mean-training-rating dummy. Low/high classifier accuracies up to 64% internal and 58% external. These are author-reported study samples, not clinical chronic-pain validation.
sources.кросс_субъект: Yes: held-out sample 2 (n=51) is a cross-subject external sample; sample 3 (n=25) is repeat sessions from sample-1 participants for within-subject temporal validation.
sources.ограничения: Publisher Version of Record checked through the University of Liverpool repository: 91 distinct people contributed 116 EEG recordings (40 development, 51 new-person cross-subject validation, and 25 repeat sessions from the development group). The 0-100 self-reported pain-rating regression did not significantly beat a mean-training-rating dummy despite reported RF MAE 19.59/21.29/18.90 across the three samples. External means held-out samples from the authors' laboratory, not an independent clinical site or chronic-pain cohort. The separate low/high classifier reached up to 64% internal and 58% external accuracy; neither task validates ECAP, SCS outcomes or clinical treatment response. Trial-level data are available only on author request.

sources.модальность: Scoping review of ECAP, position/movement and subjective-state control signals; no original participant-level measurements.
sources.задача: Evaluate the control signals and algorithms used by closed-loop SCS systems for chronic pain.
sources.метод: PRISMA-ScR search of PubMed, Scopus and Web of Science on 2024-12-14; 688 unique articles screened, 28 publications representing 19 studies included.
sources.датасет: Review corpus of 28 publications representing 19 unique studies; no participant-level ECAP/pain outcome dataset in the author abstract.
sources.ограничения: Review-level categories are not independent patient counts or linked participant data. ECAP is a neural control signal, not a direct measure of pain. Only the author abstract was directly checked; official publisher full-text route is indexed open access but returned HTTP 403 locally on 2026-09-27.

sources.авторы: Mingxuan Sun; Yang Liu; Daoshuang Geng; Xiaobang Wu; Daoguo Yang
sources.модальность: EEG
sources.задача: Four-class cold-pressor experimental pain-intensity classification from EEG, with sensitivity-group analysis
sources.производительность: Abstract (publisher first-page PDF): class accuracies 88.64% (no pain), 95.80% (mild), 99.75% (moderate), 82.96% (severe) in undivided group; 93.98% overall after sensitivity-group stratification; R²=0.45, p<0.01. Separate publisher-indexed Conclusions excerpt: 91.79% accuracy in four-level pain classification. Denominator/protocol relationship unresolved; keep distinct.
sources.ограничения: The official ScienceDirect preview exposes §2.1 Participants (26 healthy university students) and the abstract, but not the Results tables or complete validation protocol. The model-analysis denominator, fold composition, class counts and exact relation of 91.79% in indexed Conclusions to 93.98% after sensitivity stratification remain unresolved. The arithmetic match of 91.79% to four undivided-group class accuracies is an inference only. Cold-pressor experimental pain does not establish chronic-pain clinical validity, ECAP, SCS response or treatment effect.

validation.notes: ScienceDirect indexed preview checked on 2026-09-28: §2.1 reports a cohort of 26 university students (16 male, 10 female, age 22-25). Published abstract reports four undivided-group class accuracies and 93.98% overall after sensitivity-group stratification under LOSOCV. Indexed Conclusions separately reports 91.79% four-level accuracy without an accessible setup label; the relation is unresolved. Complete result tables and model-analysis denominator remain unavailable. No external clinical validation.

sources.ограничения: The GAN was trained on paired SpeakingFaces images, then synthetic thermal images were derived from BioVid RGB videos. sources.метод: Claimed method: deliver a spinal-cord stimulation pulse caudal to injury, sense elicited ECAP, identify an unspecified ECAP characteristic, determine a second therapy-parameter value from it, and deliver second therapy.

Dependent claims and specification details were not independently rechecked on this route; prior secondary-mirror findings remain dated historical context.

evidence.target_label: Unspecified symptom associated with prior spinal-cord damage; claimed therapy target, not an observed outcome.

validation.notes: USPTO Official Gazette claim 1 only: ECAP characteristic informs a second therapy-parameter value for an unspecified SCI-associated symptom. sources.название: Feature extraction and prediction of spinal cord stimulation evoked compound action potentials in humans
sources.авторы: König, S.; Ramadan, A.; Sullivan, D. et al.
sources.модальность: Epidural SCS ECAP waveforms recorded through two externalized percutaneous leads
sources.задача: Classify individual pulses as ECAP, non-ECAP or artifact and model waveform features across stimulation settings
sources.метод: Artifact cleaning, PCA clustering, K-nearest-neighbor classification and generalized linear mixed-effects models
sources.датасет: Fifteen chronic-pain participants recruited; 30 sessions from eight participants with externalized two-lead SCS selected, followed by exclusion of two sessions from one participant for uncertain electrode alignment
sources.производительность: AUC separated ECAP from non-ECAP better than peak-to-peak amplitude (d'=2.44 versus 2.27); preferred polarities reduced current by about 1.25 mA
sources.кросс_субъект: no: participant variability was modeled, but no held-out-participant validation is reported
sources.ограничения: Eight selected participants out of 15 recruited and 28 retained sessions after two exclusions. Nested k-fold classification selected every 11th waveform per outer loop; no participant-held-out evaluation or external cohort. Underlying data are available only on author request subject to ethics/IRB restrictions. ECAP classes and features are neural-response measures, not pain or treatment outcomes.

provenance.query_or_seed: Feature extraction and prediction of spinal cord stimulation evoked compound action potentials in humans

evidence.population: Fifteen recruited adults with chronic pain; eight contributed 30 selected recording sessions, of which two were excluded for uncertain electrode alignment.
evidence.target_label: Individual-pulse ECAP, non-ECAP or artifact class and waveform features

validation.notes: IOP Version of Record checked through text rendering of the official publisher PDF URL after direct IOP GET returned a Radware CAPTCHA. Methods 2.2 p. 3: 15 recruited, 30 sessions from eight selected, two sessions excluded. Methods 2.7 p. 5: outer cross-validation selects every 11th waveform, not a held-out participant. Table 1 p. 8: AUC median d-prime 2.44 for ECAP versus non-ECAP. Data availability p. 15: author request subject to ethics/IRB restrictions. No patient-level clinical pain outcome or independent validation.

sources.название: Biphasic Electrostimulation Artifact Model for ECAP Extraction in Spinal Cord Stimulation
sources.авторы: Zhang, H.; Luo, X.; Ma, B. et al.
sources.издание: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering 34, 880–893
sources.модальность: Longitudinal human SCS ECAP recordings with stimulation artifact
sources.задача: Remove biphasic stimulation artifact without distorting ECAP neural-response morphology
sources.метод: Biphasic electrostimulation artifact model based on additivity and boundary conditions; piecewise-linear ECAP growth-curve fit (Eqs. 8-9) evaluated with the E-score defined in Eq. 11 as harmonic mean of denoising and fidelity rates.
sources.датасет: Two SCS patients; nine months of therapy, 208,336 retained signals across 900 stimulation settings
sources.производительность: BEAM achieved the highest E-scores among compared methods and reduced stimulation artifacts without distorting neural-activity information; exact effect sizes require the full tables
sources.кросс_субъект: no: two-patient longitudinal technical validation without held-out-patient evaluation
sources.ограничения: Two SCS participants and no independent cohort or participant-disjoint validation. Eq. 11 and results captions define a harmonic-mean E-score, while Appendix C refers to a geometric mean; the metric actually used for reported values cannot be resolved from text alone. Artifact extraction quality is not pain intensity, analgesic response or cross-patient performance.

sources.название: Combining brain-wide activity imaging with electron microscopy reveals a distributed brain network for processing threatening somatosensory stimuli
sources.авторы: N. Randel; C. Wang; M. S. Clayton; K. Wang; S. Pang; S. C. Xu; A. Champion; H. F. Hess; A. Cardona; P. J. Keller; M. Zlatic
sources.модальность: Нейронная активность
sources.задача: Картирование
sources.метод: Same-specimen larval light-sheet calcium imaging and eFIB-SEM registration, followed by targeted two-photon validation and a separate rolling assay. Version 3 additionally models the larval connectome as a recurrent firing-rate network: synapse counts set connection strengths, predicted neurotransmitters set signs, and simulated Basin activation is compared with observed calcium-response valence. A null ensemble uses 1,000 out-degree-preserving shuffled networks.
sources.датасет: Larva1099 first-instar CNS; separate third-instar neural and behavioral preparations
sources.производительность: In one first-instar CNS, 119 of roughly 3,000 brain neurons responded to Basin activation; 25 responsive lineages and 101/119 traced neurons were reported. Separate third-instar cohorts showed reduced rolling (P=0.0037) and increased turning (P=0.025) after KC silencing during Basin activation (n=366/351; v3 Fig. 5C). Separately, v3 Figure 6 reports connectome-model AUC 0.74 (Mann-Whitney U p=0.045), response-sign accuracy 72.4%, and an out-degree-preserving-shuffle permutation p=0.025. These are author-reported within-study metrics, not reproduced or human validation.
sources.кросс_субъект: Не применимо
sources.ограничения: One first-instar CNS underlies whole-brain imaging and EM registration; validation and rolling assays use other third-instar larvae. Optogenetic Basin stimulation is an experimental proxy for nociceptive input. Calcium responses, circuit anatomy and rolling are distinct endpoints; none measures subjective pain or establishes human transfer. Version 3 Figure 6 does not report the exact evaluated-neuron denominator or a train/test split in the checked text; the reported 72.4% must not be assigned the nearby 20/26 tracing denominator. The graph-null result is a fly-neuron valence comparison, not Drosophila-to-ECAP transfer or clinical SCS evidence.

evidence.population: One first-instar CNS for matched light-sheet/EM mapping; separate third-instar preparations for neuron validation and early third-instar larvae for rolling assays
evidence.sample_size: One first-instar CNS for whole-brain/EM registration; approximately 40 early third-instar larvae per behavioral recording; validation animals counted by experiment
evidence.target_label: Basin-evoked calcium activity and separately measured rolling escape

validation.notes: v3 Figure 6 is a partial biological-model analogue only; exact evaluation N and train/test split are not reported in checked primary text; no human ECAP or SCS transfer.

sources.название: Closing the loop on chronic pain with ECAP-controlled closed-loop vs open-loop spinal cord stimulation: systematic and longitudinal pooled analysis of the EVOKE study
sources.авторы: Muhammad Ananda Miftah Redyno; Avisa Cetta Cresma; Ritma Ratri Ayunda Putri
sources.издание: JPHV (Journal of Pain, Vertigo and Headache) 7(1):37-44
sources.модальность: Published EVOKE trial outcomes and health-economic model inputs
sources.задача: Systematic review of ECAP-controlled closed-loop versus open-loop SCS
sources.метод: PRISMA review registered as PROSPERO CRD420251126075; Cochrane RoB 2 and CHEERS appraisal
sources.датасет: One eligible randomized trial program (EVOKE), 134 randomized participants, plus its companion cost-utility analysis
sources.производительность: The JPHV Abstract reports ≥50% relief RR 1.47 (95% CI 1.27–1.70) and labels the ≥80% effect “RR 0.18” (95% CI 0.08–0.27). Its Results > Pain Reduction instead calls 0.18 an absolute risk difference (RD) favoring closed-loop SCS; the statistic label is internally inconsistent and must not be used as an effect estimate without clarification. The same Results section reports a VAS pooled mean difference −3.01 (95% CI −6.12 to 0.10), whose interval includes zero. These are repeated EVOKE follow-up reports, not independent trials.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable
sources.ограничения: The publisher PDF was checked via a Googlebot user-agent while normal requests met a Cloudflare 403 challenge. JPHV Abstract p.37 labels the ≥80% effect RR 0.18 but Results p.41 labels it RD 0.18, so direction/measure cannot be reconciled from this paper. JPHV p.40 gives 36-month ≥50% response as 78% closed-loop versus 31% open-loop, whereas the primary EVOKE 36-month report gives 77.6% versus 49.3%; 31.3% is its open-loop ≥80% response. JPHV Results p.41 describes three randomized trials although the eligible 12/24/36-month reports are one EVOKE cohort (134 randomized), creating nonindependent follow-up pooling. Do not use this synthesis as an independent effect estimate, new cohort, proof that ECAP measures pain, or Indonesia-specific cost-effectiveness. The 36-month analysis has missing-data/selective-reporting concerns and non-Indonesian economic inputs.

evidence.target_label: Pain response, disability, quality of life, opioid reduction and modeled cost utility

validation.notes: The publisher PDF is a secondary synthesis of repeated follow-up reports from one EVOKE randomized trial program (134 randomized participants), not a new participant-level model or cross-subject validation. Its RR/RD 0.18 label and 36-month open-loop responder rate conflict with the source trial report; use only as bounded review context, not an independent effect estimate. The publisher PDF was accessed through a browser-agent route while ordinary requests met Cloudflare 403.

JPHV p.40 gives 36-month ≥50% response as 78% closed-loop versus 31% open-loop, whereas the primary EVOKE 36-month report gives 77.6% versus 49.3%; 31.3% is its open-loop ≥80% response. JPHV Results p.41 describes three randomized trials although the eligible 12/24/36-month reports are one EVOKE cohort (134 randomized), creating nonindependent follow-up pooling. Do not use this synthesis as an independent effect estimate, new cohort, proof that ECAP measures pain, or Indonesia-specific cost-effectiveness. The 36-month analysis has missing-data/selective-reporting concerns and non-Indonesian economic inputs.

sources.авторы: Meagan K Brucker-Hahn; Ashlesha Deshmukh; Megan Settell; Justin Chin; Aniruddha Upadhye; Igor Lavrov; Andrew J Shoffstall; Kip A Ludwig; Mingming Zhang; Scott F Lempka

sources.модальность: Swine anatomical imaging, epidural spinal recordings and simulated ECAP waveforms

sources.метод: Anatomy-derived finite-element volume conductor, multicompartment cable models and reciprocity-based ECAP observation model
sources.датасет: Imaging and epidural recordings from six swine
sources.производительность: Qualitative mechanistic agreement: morphology and amplitude varied with dorsal-CSF thickness, mediolateral lead location, tonic waveform and contact configuration even at similar neural activation

sources.ограничения: Six-swine preclinical study with no human validation. ECAP morphology and amplitude can vary at similar underlying neural activation, so waveform amplitude alone is not a direct recruitment, analgesia or pain measure.

evidence.population: Six swine with anatomical imaging and epidural spinal recordings
evidence.target_label: ECAP morphology and amplitude generated by the anatomical/electrophysiological observation model

validation.notes: The publisher-authored full-text page was read from its 2025-09-15 Internet Archive snapshot; the live Neuromodulation and ScienceDirect pages returned HTTP 403 during this recheck. The archived page confirms the six-swine experimental/modeling methods, ECAP morphology/amplitude results, and publication history (published online 2025-08-06). No human validation is reported; calibration details were not found in the accessible full text. ECAP waveform amplitude alone is not a direct analgesia or pain measure.

validation.notes: BANC v888 is one adult female's brain-and-cord anatomy. Its graph influence analysis is not a calibrated biophysical dynamics model or an ECAP/SCS measurement operator; circuit comparisons are anatomical and functional context, not clinical validation. Nature owner page confirms Version of Record 2026-07-29 (online publication 2026-06-08; issue 2026-08-27), with no correction/retraction notice. Its reference 216 explicitly cites the same-titled bioRxiv preprint DOI 10.1101/2025.07.31.667571; The bioRxiv owner details API now lists v1 (2025-08-01), v2 (2025-08-02) and v3 (2026-02-14) for DOI 10.1101/2025.07.31.667571 and names published DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10735-w; Nature reference 216 identifies the same preprint. Targeted comparison of v3 Abstract, Figure 1/dataset text and Discussion with the Nature VOR found changed counts and interpretation; the current matrix claim uses the VOR only, not preprint equivalence. No efficacy inference. Version identity and bounded delta checked 2026-09-28.

relations.note: Nature VOR front matter identifies the same-titled bioRxiv preprint as a previous version; reference 216 identifies its DOI.

Methods Statistical analysis reports mean +/- s.d. for model/noise replicates; there is no uncertainty estimate over independently held-out flies. sources.метод: Dynamic VNC network simulation, descending-neuron activation screen and circuit pruning

sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable
sources.ограничения: Preprint on walking CPGs. DNg100-driven front-leg motor rhythms were compared across four connectome datasets, while pruning results identify shared E1/E2 and inhibitory-node motif components with dataset-specific minimal circuits (the common FANC minimal circuit has four interneurons). The six-leg bilateral output figures (Fig. 4; Extended Data Fig. 9) use the full MANC dataset; Extended Data Fig. 8 shows MANC cell types across all six leg neuropils but only the FANC front-left neuropil. Although the Abstract/Results generalize the motif across all six legs and four datasets, these figures do not show six-leg rhythmic output for each of the four datasets. The DNb08 optogenetic assay tests a separate motor pathway in decapitated flies. This is a motor-circuit comparator, not nociception, ECAP or SCS validation.

validation.notes: Preprint on walking CPGs. Four VNC-containing connectomes and both sexes support computational motif robustness. Optogenetic activation of DNb08 in decapitated flies tests a separate predicted pathway. This is a motor-circuit comparator, not nociception, ECAP or SCS validation. SRC-07 2026-09-25: PMC JATS for the author preprint explicitly has article-version number 2 and PMCID version PMC13142387.2, dated 30 April 2026. Crossref's 2025 DOI date is the initial deposit date; no journal identity follows from this JATS. SRC-03 scope review 2026-09-27: the Abstract/Results describe six-leg/four-dataset circuit generality. The dataset-specific Methods and captions scope four-dataset DNg100 comparisons to front-leg subnetworks, while the full six-leg output/phase analysis is full MANC only; Extended Data Fig. 8 depicts all six MANC neuropils but only FANC front-left.

sources.название: Connectome-constrained networks predict neural activity across the fly visual system
sources.авторы: Janne K. Lappalainen; Fabian D. Tschopp; Sridhama Prakhya; Mason McGill; Aljoscha Nern; Kazunori Shinomiya; Shin-ya Takemura; Eyal Gruntman; Jakob H. Macke; Srinivas C. Turaga
sources.модальность: connectome, neural_activity
sources.задача: Оценка идентифицируемости и вклада структурных ограничений коннектома
sources.метод: Connectome-constrained deep mechanistic network with simplified neurons and synapses, optimized for visual motion
sources.датасет: Compiled adult fly visual-system connectome; official flyvis scaffold fib25-fib19_v2.2.json; 64 cell types
sources.производительность: Predicts neural responses across 64 visual-system cell types and tests connectome-derived constraints.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable
sources.ограничения: The 64-cell-type visual network predicts measured single-neuron visual responses. The official flyvis implementation names the compiled scaffold fib25-fib19_v2.2.json; this is a constructed file, not a single FlyWire/BANC release. The endpoint is visual function, not VNC, nociception, ECAP or SCS.

provenance.query_or_seed: connectome-constrained dynamics transfer random graph controls

evidence.population: Adult Drosophila visual system; 64 modeled cell types with published functional recordings
evidence.sample_size: 64 modeled optic-lobe cell types; 45,669 model neurons; 1,513,231 model connections across 721 columns; 50 independently trained DMNs; comparisons to published neural recordings from 26 studies (not 26 animals).
evidence.target_label: connectome-constrained neural dynamics

validation.notes: The 64-cell-type visual network predicts measured single-neuron visual responses. The official flyvis implementation names the compiled scaffold fib25-fib19_v2.2.json; this is a constructed file, not a single FlyWire/BANC release. The endpoint is visual function, not VNC, nociception, ECAP or SCS. A prior relation to bioRxiv 10.1101/2023.05.02.539144 was removed: that preprint is Shiu et al., a distinct adult-brain model. BioRxiv 10.1101/2023.03.11.532232 matches Lappalainen et al. by title and authors, but a formal publisher-declared version link was not verified. Rechecked 2026-09-28: model predictions were compared with published neural recordings from 26 studies without fitting to those recordings; this is external within-species functional comparison, not human transfer. The paper reports 95% confidence intervals for some cross-model correlations, not predictive uncertainty or calibration. Model size and ensemble count are not biological animal sample sizes.

sources.название: Randomized Modality Mixing with Patchwise RBF Networks for Robust Multimodal Pain Recognition
sources.авторы: Mehmet Erdal; Sascha Gruss; Steffen Walter; Friedhelm Schwenker
sources.модальность: ECG, EDA and EMG physiological features; facial video excluded
sources.задача: Robust multimodal experimental-pain recognition under limited training data
sources.метод: Randomized modality mixing plus patchwise radial-basis-function networks and ensemble aggregation
sources.датасет: X-ITE: 134 subjects, 30 selected as test subjects, 10 trials per subject; BioVid Part A: 87 recorded, 80 analyzed after seven exclusions
sources.производительность: X-ITE RBF-Patch-Net with ModMix: 87.1 ± 11.3% mean accuracy versus 86.4 ± 10.3% without augmentation; 12/30 subjects improved, 7 unchanged, 11 worsened. BioVid without augmentation: both compared models approximately 81% mean accuracy.
sources.кросс_субъект: Yes: each X-ITE trial excludes the test subject from training; BioVid uses the remaining subjects as training
sources.ограничения: Experimental thermal/electrical pain classification in healthy volunteers, not clinical SCS outcomes. X-ITE uses a participant-disjoint test subject in each trial, but the 30 subjects are not one fixed independent holdout across trials. ModMix improves mean accuracy by about 0.7 percentage points and worsens 11/30 subjects. BioVid final analysis omits augmentation; no independent external validation of ModMix or patient-level prospective validation is reported. Hyperparameter grid-search selection unit is unclear.

provenance.query_or_seed: exact ModMix title author version search

evidence.population: Healthy X-ITE and BioVid participants; X-ITE 134 total/30 tested, BioVid 87 total/80 analyzed
evidence.sample_size: X-ITE 134 subjects, 30 tested; BioVid 87 recorded, 80 analyzed

validation.notes: Official publisher PDF checked (SHA-256 1805489e984deb4673e0a3c2fd236a66167331acd82df5899e0e75175088a28f). X-ITE tests 30 selected subjects with 10 participant-disjoint trials each; training uses 2500 observations from the other 133 subjects and 500 augmented training points. BioVid tests 80 analyzed subjects with 3000 observations drawn from the other subjects, five runs, and no augmentation in the final analysis. ModMix data filtering uses a network trained on original data; tuning selection and code-level fold reproduction were not established.

relations.note: Expanded open-access journal treatment of the ModMix method introduced in the ICPR workshop chapter.

sources.авторы: Nagy Mekhail; Sherif Armanyous; Erin Templeton; Nicholas Prayson; Youssef Saweris
sources.издание: Neuromodulation: Technology at the Neural Interface
sources.модальность: Preimplant demographic, clinical and pain-diagnosis variables; no ECAP
sources.задача: Externally validate a previously developed clinical formula for 6-month SCS response
sources.метод: Logistic prediction formula developed at one center, prospectively tested in a multicenter product-surveillance registry
sources.датасет: 939 enrolled after successful SCS or targeted-drug-delivery trials; 619 SCS recipients and 320 TDD recipients
sources.производительность: External registry validation: 138/619 SCS recipients met the six-month >=50% VAS-reduction target; author abstract AUROC 0.80. Official Supplementary Figure 3 reports SCS classification accuracy 87.3%; Supplementary Table 1 rounds SCS accuracy to 87% (95% interval 84–90), sensitivity 67% (58–74) and specificity 93% (91–95). These accuracy and discrimination measures are separate; TDD results are a different cohort.
sources.кросс_субъект: yes
sources.ограничения: The PubMed author abstract and official Elsevier supplementary DOCX were reviewed; the main publisher article body returned HTTP 403. Supplementary Table 2 gives SCS failed/success counts 481/138 (n=619) and separate TDD counts 173/147 (n=320). The supplement gives intervals for classification metrics, but no AUROC interval, calibration, participant-level rows, code, fold membership or full model refitting/split protocol. The 939 combined recipients must not be treated as one SCS cohort. PubMed uses >=50% while the supplement uses >50% VAS reduction; equality handling is unresolved without patient rows/code. No ECAP predictor is reported.

SCS 481/138 failed/successful at six months (n=619); SCS accuracy 87.3% in Figure 3 and rounded 87% (84–90) in Table 1. Confidence intervals apply to classification metrics, not to the abstract AUROC 0.80. Main body HTTP 403; split/refitting details, calibration and reusable patient rows remain unverified. PubMed >=50% and supplement >50% responder wording differ; equality handling is unresolved. No ECAP predictor. Full-text status remains metadata_only because only the abstract and supplement, not the article body, were accessible.

sources.название: Choice of spinal cord stimulation versus targeted drug delivery in the management of chronic pain: a predictive formula for outcomes
sources.авторы: Nagy Mekhail; Diana S. Mehanny; Sherif Armanyous; Shrif Costandi; Youssef Saweris; Gerges Azer; Robert Bolash
sources.модальность: Retrospective clinical and demographic variables; no ECAP
sources.задача: Derive formula for SCS success versus subsequent targeted drug delivery after SCS failure
sources.метод: Retrospective univariate and multivariate analysis with a logistic SCS-success formula
sources.датасет: 945 Cleveland Clinic SCS-trial records from 1994–2013; 119 later achieved adequate relief with TDD after SCS failure
sources.производительность: Author abstract reports predictor directions but no held-out performance for the derived formula
sources.кросс_субъект: unavailable_after_search
sources.ограничения: Publisher Methods defines SCS success as at least 50% pain relief from the trial and subsequent implant. Results reports 945 included and Table 1 partitions 826 SCS successes and 119 failures later treated with TDD, but no model-specific complete-case denominator or fixed follow-up horizon is stated. The narrative predictive formula includes a +0.468 postlaminectomy term that Table 4 omits; the printed formula is internally inconsistent. Discussion mentions 95% cross-validation accuracy without its denominator, split protocol or confusion matrix, while Results reports AUC 0.7414. This is single-center derivation, not external validation; no ECAP.

provenance.query_or_seed: Choice of spinal cord stimulation versus targeted drug delivery in the management of chronic pain: a predictive formula for outcomes

evidence.population: Chronic nonmalignant pain patients undergoing SCS trial; TDD subgroup followed SCS failure
evidence.target_label: At least 50% pain relief from SCS trial and subsequent implant for SCS success; fixed follow-up horizon not reported

validation.notes: Publisher BMJ full-text JATS XML checked 2026-09-27. Methods defines at least 50% pain relief from trial and subsequent implant. Results/Table 1 report 945 included (826 successes, 119 failures); the exact model complete-case N and fixed outcome horizon are not reported. Results narrative includes a +0.468 postlaminectomy coefficient omitted from Table 4. Discussion states 95% cross-validation accuracy without a printed split, denominator or confusion matrix; Results separately reports AUC 0.7414. No patient-disjoint or external validation is inferred. Data are available on reasonable request; no ECAP predictor is described.

sources.название: High-dose spinal cord stimulation for patients with failed back surgery syndrome: a multicenter effectiveness and prediction study
sources.авторы: Lisa Goudman; Ann De Smedt; Sam Eldabe; Philippe Rigoard; Bengt Linderoth; Mats De Jaeger; Discover Consortium; Maarten Moens
sources.модальность: Baseline clinical and patient-reported outcomes; no ECAP
sources.задача: Predict 12-month holistic response to high-dose SCS in failed back surgery syndrome
sources.метод: Multicenter Discover registry; longitudinal effectiveness analysis plus logistic regression and decision tree for holistic response
sources.датасет: 194 recruited; 185 baseline visits; 92 still receiving high-dose SCS at 12 months; model analysis denominator unavailable in abstract
sources.производительность: Author abstract reports 90% sensitivity and specificity for holistic response, without a visible validation split or denominator
sources.кросс_субъект: unavailable_after_search
sources.ограничения: Publisher full text defines a 12-month holistic responder requiring all four changes: 33% improvement in both low-back and leg NRS, 30% ODI improvement, EQ-5D increase of at least 0.03, and medication decrease. A distinct four-week trial-success rule uses 50% pain and medication reduction and must not be substituted. The primary article reports 80/20 train-validation and five random validation sets, but no prediction-specific N, per-split denominators, split unit or patient-disjointness. No external validation or ECAP; related Discover-registry cohorts may overlap. Live LWW access is restricted; review used a 2021 capture of the publisher page.

provenance.query_or_seed: Goudman 2021 PMID 32910099

evidence.population: Adults with failed back surgery syndrome recruited to the multicenter Discover registry for high-dose SCS
evidence.sample_size: 194 recruited; 185 baseline; 92 receiving HD-SCS at 12 months
evidence.target_label: Twelve-month holistic responder: 33% better low-back and leg NRS, 30% better ODI, EQ-5D gain at least 0.03, and medication decrease; missing outcome components imply unknown status

validation.notes: The 2021 Internet Archive capture of the original LWW publisher full text was reviewed directly on 2026-09-27; live LWW access returned 403. Methods §2.5 and Figure 3 define the four-part 12-month holistic response; separate four-week trial-success thresholds are not interchangeable. Logistic/CART methods report 80/20 train-validation with five random validation sets. Cohort flow is 194 recruited, 185 baseline and 92 remaining on HD-SCS at 12 months, but prediction-specific N, absolute split Ns, patient-disjointness and row linkage are not printed. No ECAP predictor or external cohort is established.

sources.название: Methods and system for recording human physiological signals from implantable leads during spinal cord stimulation
sources.авторы: Ahmed Ramadan; Seth D. König; Mingming Zhang; Erika K. Ross; Alexander Herman; Théoden I. Netoff; David P. Darrow
sources.модальность: Human epidural SCS recordings and ECAP signal processing
sources.задача: Assess hardware settings and artifact-removal fits for ECAP measurement during SCS
sources.метод: Two trial patients with externalized leads; fit single exponential, double exponential and second-order polynomial to averaged recordings at 0.375-4 ms after stimulation, then subtract each fit and compare ECAP N1 timing, P2-N1 amplitude and fit computation time
sources.датасет: Two participants, 20 observations across visits and stimulation parameters; one observation is one or more concatenated trials, not an independent participant
sources.производительность: Double exponential fit gave the best artifact fit; second-order polynomial gave similar ECAP N1 timing and P2-N1 amplitude with shorter computation time in the tested recordings
sources.кросс_субъект: no: methods comparison used repeated recordings from two participants
sources.ограничения: Technical ECAP extraction from only two patients; no independent held-out-patient evaluation or clinical pain-outcome prediction. The authors caution that curve fitting may overestimate or underestimate neural response and that averaging opposite polarities can distort ECAP morphology.

sources.название: Evoked potentials recorded from the spinal cord during neurostimulation for pain: a computational modeling study
sources.авторы: Carlos J. Anaya; Hans J. Zander; Robert D. Graham; Vishwanath Sankarasubramanian; Scott F. Lempka
sources.модальность: Simulated spinal ECAP and published human ECAP trace comparator
sources.задача: Explain the neural and physical origins of ECAPs recorded from SCS leads
sources.метод: Lower-thoracic 3-D finite-element volume conductor in COMSOL, multicompartment dorsal-column sensory axons in NEURON, and reciprocity-based projection of axonal transmembrane currents to inactive lead contacts
sources.датасет: Literature-based canonical human anatomy and axon-density inputs; one previously published clinical ECAP trace shown as a comparator in Figure 2C, not a new patient cohort
sources.производительность: At assumed model discomfort threshold, Figure 2C shows clinical and model P2-N1 amplitudes of 200 and 216 microvolts; qualitative N1/P2 morphology and latency agreement, not patient-independent prediction
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no patient-level model training or held-out-patient test
sources.ограничения: Canonical literature-based anatomy and lead placement omit interpatient variation. Model sensory threshold is assumed at at least 10% dorsal-column activation and discomfort threshold at 1.4 times this threshold, without established clinical mapping. Dorsal horn neurons are excluded; no new patient-linked pain-outcome validation.

sources.название: Evoked compound action potentials during spinal cord stimulation: effects of posture and pulse width on signal features and neural activation within the spinal cord
sources.авторы: Meagan K. Brucker-Hahn; Hans J. Zander; Andrew J. Will; Jayesh C. Vallabh; Jason S. Wolff; David A. Dinsmoor; Scott F. Lempka
sources.модальность: Human spinal ECAP recordings plus computational dorsal-column recruitment model
sources.задача: Measure how posture and pulse width alter spinal ECAP features and test whether constant ECAP amplitude implies constant neural recruitment
sources.метод: Acute externalized SCS-trial ECAP growth-curve sweeps across postures and 90-300 microsecond pulse widths; artifact model and growth-curve estimation; FEM and 10,000 dorsal-column axons with reciprocity-based ECAP simulation across dorsal CSF thicknesses
sources.датасет: 56 trial participants and 479 trials; 195 trials excluded from growth-curve fitting; analyzed 284 datasets from 45 participants. Human recordings are commercially sensitive and available only upon reasonable request, not public download.
sources.производительность: Experimental supine versus seated ECAP threshold was 65.7% lower and growth rate 178.5% higher; in the model a fixed 25 microvolt ECAP required 94% more activated axons at 4.4 mm versus 2.0 mm dorsal CSF thickness
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: descriptive repeated-measure analysis, no held-out participant predictive model
sources.ограничения: Acute trial-phase recordings only; 11 of 56 participants had all growth-curve trials excluded. Model lacked stimulation artifact and biological noise, used averaged anatomy, and did not predict patient-linked analgesic outcomes. Constant ECAP amplitude failed to guarantee constant recruitment in simulation.

sources.название: Diversity of meso-scale architecture in human and non-human connectomes
sources.авторы: Richard F. Betzel; John D. Medaglia; Danielle S. Bassett
sources.модальность: Published inter-areal structural connectomes across Drosophila, mouse, rat, macaque and human; human functional connectivity and mouse gene co-expression as separate comparisons
sources.задача: Compare assortative, core-periphery and disassortative mesoscale community organization across species
sources.метод: Weighted stochastic blockmodel fitted to inter-areal connectomes and compared with modularity maximization over K=2-10 communities, with 250 runs per K; community-interaction motifs and diversity indices were analyzed
sources.датасет: Previously published inter-areal connectomes in five species; Drosophila analysis is supplementary. The main text models group-representative human connectome data. Data availability states that study data are obtainable from authors on reasonable request.
sources.производительность: In human data, weighted stochastic-blockmodel partitions aligned more strongly with functional-connectivity within-versus-between community contrast than modularity partitions; no cross-species transfer score or ECAP/SCS metric was reported
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: descriptive cross-species graph comparison, not a participant-disjoint predictive transfer test
sources.ограничения: The Drosophila and human graphs are compared at inter-areal mesoscale, not neuron-level FlyWire/VNC resolution. Human functional-connectivity corroboration does not validate a Drosophila-to-human dynamical representation, causal invariant, ECAP operator or SCS outcome.

sources.название: A Drosophila computational brain model reveals sensorimotor processing
sources.авторы: Philip K. Shiu; Gabriella R. Sterne; Nico Spiller; Romain Franconville; Andrea Sandoval; et al.
sources.модальность: Adult Drosophila FlyWire central-brain connectome, predicted neurotransmitter identity, simulated spike activity, optogenetic activation and feeding/grooming observations
sources.задача: Predict sensorimotor responses in feeding and antennal grooming circuits from a whole-brain connectome model
sources.метод: Brainwide leaky integrate-and-fire model with alpha-synapse dynamics on connectome weights and predicted excitatory/inhibitory identities; sensory and interneuron activation compared with neural and behavioral experiments
sources.датасет: Adult FlyWire central-brain connectome, public materialization v.630, with 127,400 proofread neurons included in the leaky integrate-and-fire model; the article describes over 125,000 neurons and 50 million synaptic connections in the broader connectome.
sources.производительность: Model predictions of taste-responsive and feeding-initiating neurons, taste interactions and antennal grooming circuits are tested by optogenetic activation and behavioral or neural observations; no pain, ECAP or SCS metric
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: connectome simulation and fly experiments, not human participant prediction
sources.ограничения: The model concerns adult central-brain feeding and grooming circuits, not VNC walking or nociceptive subjective pain. Authors caution that absolute model firing rates are unreliable because morphology, receptor dynamics, gap junctions, peptides and neuromodulation are omitted. Fly experiments validate scoped circuit hypotheses, not human ECAP or SCS outcomes.

sources.название: painless, a Drosophila Gene Essential for Nociception
sources.авторы: W. Daniel Tracey Jr.; Rachel I. Wilson; Gilles Laurent; Seymour Benzer
sources.модальность: Larval heated-probe and mechanical behavioral assays, multidendritic-neuron genetic silencing, nerve electrophysiology and painless mutant/rescue tests
sources.задача: Identify a gene and peripheral neurons required for thermal and mechanical nociceptive escape in Drosophila larvae
sources.метод: Heated probe rolling assay and EP-element mutant screen; multidendritic GAL4/TeTxLC silencing; larval nerve recordings; painless gene rescue and expression localization
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster larvae; experiment-specific animal and nerve counts in figures, without one whole-study denominator
sources.производительность: Results prose: a 45 mN von Frey mechanical filament evoked rolling in 92% of wild-type larvae (n=36) versus 13% of painless1 mutants (n=31); the mechanical percentages are not assigned to Figure 2E. Figure 2E concerns heat-probe responses. Figure 3C-E reports temperature-linked peripheral nerve firing in wild type and its absence in painless mutants.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no subject-level predictive model
sources.ограничения: Peripheral nerve firing and protective larval rolling are different observables; neither directly measures subjective pain. Genetic silencing does not exclude untargeted neurons. sources.авторы: Nagy Mekhail; Robert M. Levy; Timothy R. Deer; Leonardo Kapural; Sean Li; Kasra Amirdelfan; Corey W. Hunter; Steven M. Rosen; Shrif J. Costandi; Steven M. Falowski; Abram H. sources.задача: Randomised double-blind comparison of ECAP-controlled closed-loop versus fixed-output open-loop spinal cord stimulation for chronic back and leg pain
sources.метод: Multicentre, double-blind, parallel-arm randomised controlled trial (1:1) at 13 US clinics; computer-generated randomisation in permuted blocks of 4 and 6 stratified by site; patients, investigators and site staff masked. The primary outcome was tested for non-inferiority (delta=10%) then superiority in the intention-to-treat population at 3 months (primary analysis) and 12 months (additional prespecified analysis) after permanent implant. Registered as NCT02924129; trial ongoing (36-month follow-up). Evidence basis for this card is the PubMed abstract only: the Elsevier full text is subscription-gated and no open-access deposit exists.
sources.датасет: 134 randomised participants (67 closed-loop, 67 open-loop); intention-to-treat analysis population 125 at 3 months (62 closed-loop, 63 open-loop) and 118 at 12 months (59/59)
sources.производительность: Primary outcome (>=50% reduction in overall back and leg pain with no increase in pain medication) met in 51/62 (82.3%) closed-loop vs 38/63 (60.3%) open-loop at 3 months (difference 21.9%, 95% CI 6.6-37.3; p=0.0052) and in 49/59 (83.1%) vs 36/59 (61.0%) at 12 months (difference 22.0%, 95% CI 6.3-37.7; p=0.0060); no differences in safety profiles
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: randomised controlled trial, not a predictive model
sources.ограничения: Publisher full text was not legally accessible during verification, so only the PubMed abstract was extracted; denominators, effect estimates and confidence intervals are abstract-level and were not cross-checked against tables or figures. The 12-month analysis is intention-to-treat and the abstract does not expose the missing-data handling. ECAP is a proxy for neural recruitment and dose, not a direct pain measurement.

sources.авторы: Nagy A Mekhail; Robert M Levy; Timothy R Deer; Leonardo Kapural; Sean Li; Kasra Amirdelfan; Jason E Pope; Corey W Hunter; Steven M Rosen; Shrif J Costandi; Steven M Falowski; Abram H Burgher; Christopher A Gilmore; Farooq A Qureshi; Peter S Staats; James Scowcroft; Tory McJunkin; Jonathan Carlson; Christopher K Kim; Michael I Yang; Thomas Stauss; Erika A Petersen; Jonathan M Hagedorn; Richard Rauck; Jan W Kallewaard; Ganesan Baranidharan; Rod S Taylor; Lawrence Poree; Dan Brounstein; Rui V Duarte; Gerrit E Gmel; Robert Gorman; Ian Gould; Erin Hanson; Dean M Karantonis; Abeer Khurram; Angela Leitner; Dave Mugan; Milan Obradovic; Zhonghua Ouyang; John Parker; Peter Single; Nicole Soliday; EVOKE Study Group
sources.издание: Regional Anesthesia & Pain Medicine 49(5):346-354; online 27 August 2023
sources.модальность: ECAP-controlled closed-loop versus fixed-output open-loop SCS with patient-reported pain, holistic response and device neural-activation measures
sources.задача: Compare long-term clinical and neurophysiological outcomes of ECAP-controlled and open-loop SCS at 36 months
sources.метод: Blinded randomized parallel-arm follow-up of NCT02924129; all 134 randomized patients included in the 36-month intention-to-treat pain analysis with last-value-carried-forward for missing values; crossover counted as failure in a secondary analysis
sources.датасет: Same EVOKE randomized cohort as S779 and S780: 134 randomized (67/67), 113 implanted (59/54); group outcomes analyzed at 36 months
sources.производительность: At 36 months, at least 50% overall back-and-leg pain reduction: 77.6% closed-loop versus 49.3% open-loop (difference 28.4%, 95% CI 12.8-43.9, p<0.001); at least 80% reduction: 49.3% versus 31.3% (difference 17.9%, 95% CI 1.6-34.2, p=0.032)
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: randomized therapy comparison, no preimplant prognostic model
sources.ограничения: The 36-month analysis was not prespecified. Last-value-carried-forward makes an assumption about missing outcomes. Both arms used the same device and ECAP-guided programming, limiting comparison with conventional open-loop care. This is the same NCT02924129 cohort as S779/S780, not independent replication; ECAP is a neural-feedback signal, not a direct pain measure. Patient-level data require sponsor request and are not openly downloadable.

sources.авторы: R. Gnana Praveen; Eric Granger; Patrick Cardinal
sources.издание: 2020 15th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (FG), pp. 473-480; arXiv:1910.08173
sources.модальность: Facial video
sources.задача: Weakly supervised cross-domain pain-intensity localization from facial video; transfer from RECOLA to UNBC-McMaster
sources.метод: I3D, multiple-instance learning, adversarial weakly supervised domain adaptation; source, target and domain losses
sources.датасет: Fully labeled RECOLA source videos; weakly labeled UNBC-McMaster target videos. UNBC: 25 participants, 200 videos, 47,398 frames.
sources.производительность: LOSO reported: 15 train, 9 validation, 1 test subject each fold; separate one-target-subject experiment. Tables I-II report differing PCC/MAE setups; do not combine.
sources.кросс_субъект: Yes: UNBC leave-one-subject-out is reported; a separate one-target-subject experiment is also described.
sources.ограничения: No synthetic pain generation. Transfers real fully labeled RECOLA source video to weakly labeled UNBC target video. Pain-domain-adaptation prior art, distinct from S149 synthetic-source unlabeled-target adaptation; facial video results do not validate SCS/ECAP.

evidence.target_label: Frame-level PSPI 0-15, quantized with an unresolved count discrepancy: text says five levels but enumerates six groups labeled 0-5; weak sequence labels for target-domain training

validation.notes: ArXiv full text: source=fully labeled RECOLA, target=weakly labeled UNBC. Table I is a one-target-subject experiment; Table II reports separate frame and sequence metrics. No synthetic pain. The UNBC quantization wording is internally inconsistent: five stated levels versus six enumerated groups (0-5). RECOLA source annotations are affective arousal/valence, not pain labels; their cross-label mapping is unresolved.

sources.название: Durability of Evoked Compound Action Potential (ECAP)-Controlled, Closed-Loop Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS) in a Real-World European Chronic Pain Population
sources.авторы: Harold Nijhuis; Jan-Willem Kallewaard; Johan van de Minkelis; Willem-Jan Hofsté; Lars Elzinga; Philippa Armstrong; Ismaïl Gültuna; Emre Almac; Ganesan Baranidharan; Serge Nikolic; Ashish Gulve; Jan Vesper; Birte E. Dietz; Dave Mugan; Frank J. P. M. Huygen
sources.модальность: Prospective multicenter observational real-world cohort; ECAP-controlled closed-loop SCS device metrics and patient-reported pain outcomes (VNRS)
sources.задача: Describe clinical pain outcomes and electrophysiological/device metrics in routine ECAP-controlled closed-loop SCS use in European chronic-pain centers
sources.метод: Prospective non-interventional data collection in 13 European centers. Standard-care implants were followed at 3, 6, and 12 months; pain VNRS and ECAP device metrics were summarized. No randomized control group or blinding. Written informed consent was obtained for use of patient data. Dutch centers received ethics committee affirmation W17_309#17.362 and the article states formal approval was not required under WMO; German and UK registrations/reviews are reported.
sources.датасет: 148 newly implanted patients overall; baseline VNRS n=148; follow-up VNRS n=103 at 3 months, n=91 at 6 months, n=85 at 12 months. Separate stimulation-naive cohort baseline n=135, follow-up n=93/82/76. ECAP metrics had different patient denominators (n=236/230/254 across metrics), not interchangeable with the 148 new implant cohort.
sources.производительность: Overall mean VNRS 8.2 at baseline (n=148), 2.6 at 3 months (n=103), 2.7 at 6 months (n=91), 2.6 at 12 months (n=85). In stimulation-naive patients, pain relief 71% (3m) and 70% (12m); exploratory nonrandomized comparisons with AVALON/EVOKE were not statistically different. ECAP metrics: median 90% time above threshold, dose ratio 1.3, dose accuracy 4.4 uV, with denominators 236, 230, 254 respectively.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: observational outcomes study, not a predictive model
sources.ограничения: No randomized comparator, no blinding, variable follow-up and substantial missing visits (including COVID-related cancellations); denominators differ across outcomes, visits, and device metrics. Results text reports 65/85 (77%) responders at 12 months while Fig. 1 caption says 76%. The study was funded by device manufacturer Saluda Medical; several authors report financial relationships with the sponsor. Routine-care sample and center/device context limit generalization. No prospective outcome-prediction model, held-out patient split, or external validation. ECAP is neural activation/dose feedback, not a direct pain measure. Data Availability says analyzed data are included in article; no separate participant-level downloadable dataset identified.

sources.название: Canine EEG helps human: cross-species and cross-modality epileptic seizure detection via multi-space alignment
sources.авторы: Ziwei Wang; Siyang Li; Dongrui Wu
sources.модальность: Canine and human intracranial EEG; human scalp EEG
sources.задача: Cross-species and cross-modality detection of ictal versus interictal EEG trials
sources.метод: ResizeNet plus multi-space alignment of input, feature and output spaces; canine-to-human and human-to-canine transfer, with unsupervised and semi-supervised target-data scenarios
sources.датасет: Kaggle canine and human iEEG; Freiburg human iEEG; CHSZ and NICU human scalp EEG. Four heterogeneous datasets, without one combined subject denominator.
sources.производительность: Table 1: mean unsupervised MSA AUC 75.53% canine-to-human and 76.89% human-to-canine across four tasks. Tables 2-3 report semi-supervised results; the abstract's over-90% AUC refers to cases with limited labeled target data, not the unsupervised setting.
sources.кросс_субъект: Unsupervised: source-species labels only, each target subject tested separately. Semi-supervised: 5-20% labeled trials per class from the same target subject used in training; remaining trials from that subject used for testing.
sources.ограничения: Seizure detection on dog/human EEG is a methodological analogue for cross-species signal transfer. It does not use a Drosophila connectome, graph-derived causal invariant, spinal ECAP, SCS treatment, or pain outcome. Semi-supervised target-subject trial results cannot be described as subject-disjoint zero-shot transfer.

validation.notes: Publisher full text checked: Results and Analysis > Dataset introduction, Transfer learning approaches, Tables 1-3. Unsupervised evaluation tests target subjects using only other-species labels; semi-supervised evaluation trains on 5-20% labeled trials of each same target subject. Neither scenario establishes Drosophila-to-ECAP/SCS translation.

sources.авторы: Tomoko Ohyama; Casey M. Schneider-Mizell; Richard D. Fetter; Javier Valdes Aleman; Romain Franconville; Marta Rivera-Alba; Brett D. Mensh; Kristin M. Branson; Julie H. Simpson; James W. Truman; Albert Cardona; Marta Zlatic
sources.модальность: Thermogenetic MD IV nociceptor activation plus chordotonal vibration; GCaMP calcium imaging, electron-microscopy circuit reconstruction and larval escape behavior
sources.задача: Test how multilevel convergence of mechanosensory and nociceptive inputs shapes larval escape-mode selection
sources.метод: Behavioral multisensory assay; dTRPA1 thermogenetic activation, P2X2/ATP functional-connectivity stimulation, GCaMP6/6s imaging, optogenetics and EM reconstruction; Extended Data Fig. 8 uses a simple steady-state rate model
sources.датасет: Foraging third-instar Drosophila larvae in behavioral assays; separate wandering third-instar CNS preparations for functional imaging and early-larval specimens for EM volumes; assay-specific sample sizes, no common study-wide N
sources.производительность: Combined mechanosensory vibration (1,000 Hz, 6.7 m/s^2) and MD IV dTRPA1 activation (32 C) synergistically increase rolling versus unimodal cues; behavior is probabilistic and includes roll-fast-crawl or fast-crawl alone
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no predictive model or cross-subject evaluation
sources.ограничения: Nociceptive input is operationalized as MD IV sensory-neuron activation; the main behavioral assay substitutes thermogenetic dTRPA1 activation for a noxious sting. Outcomes are larval escape behavior and GCaMP calcium signals, not subjective pain. EM anatomy and physiology use distinct preparations/cohorts. Extended Data Fig. 8 is a simplified steady-state firing-rate toy model, not a dynamic connectome simulation. No human data, ECAP or SCS outcomes.

sources.датасет: Ten swine (six male, four female); analysis-specific denominators vary, including n=5 for referencing comparisons and n=4 for lead-migration analyses. Underlying data are Abbott proprietary and confidential; Abbott is not obligated to release them to third parties.

sources.ограничения: Acute swine physiology only; no human cohort, pain/analgesia outcome or FEM/axon physical ECAP forward operator. Raw data are Abbott proprietary and confidential, with no obligation to release them. This study and S798 are from the same research consortium with substantial author overlap; related technical evidence, not independent external validation.

No human pain outcome or FEM/axon physical forward operator.

sources.название: Cross-modal modulation gates nociceptive inputs in Drosophila
sources.авторы: Geng Pan; Ruonan Li; Guozhong Xu; Shijun Weng; Xiong-li Yang; Limin Yang; Bing Ye
sources.модальность: Thermal heat-plate and optogenetic C4da nociceptor stimulation; gentle mechanical touch and Cho mechanosensory modulation; separate larval neural-activity and behavior assays
sources.задача: Test how low-threshold mechanosensory input gates weak nociceptive input at the larval second-order neuron A08n and changes protective escape behavior
sources.метод: Separate assays: heat-plate behavior at 27.5/39°C with optogenetic Cho inhibition; C4da ChR2 activation with 470-nm light and Cho GtACR1 inhibition with 617-nm light; whole-cell patch clamp of second-order neurons in opened/pinned larval preparations retaining PNS and CNS; Cho-terminal GCaMP6f imaging; intact-larva rolling and dry-hard-agar crawling assays
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster larval experimental cohorts. Behavioral assays, opened/pinned electrophysiology preparations, and calcium-imaging preparations are separate assay readouts; the paper does not report a pooled study-wide animal count or animal-level cross-assay linkage.
sources.производительность: Stimulus and modulation: gentle touch (10–16 mN in Fig. 1E; 10 mN in Fig. 2A) was paired with optogenetic C4da nociceptor activation (470 nm; Fig. 2A uses 50 ms, 0.40–8.89 µW/mm²); Cho activity was separately manipulated with GtACR1 or P2X2. Neural readout: whole-cell recordings show touch suppresses the number of A08n spikelets during weak C4da activation (0.40–1.04 µW/mm²) but not stronger activation; these are recorded spike-like depolarizations termed spikelets, not asserted action potentials. Touch enhanced Basin-4/Wave depolarization in Fig. 1E. Cho-terminal GCaMP6f imaging in Fig. S1A-B confirms touch activates Cho neurons. Behavior: Cho inhibition increased heat-evoked rolling at 27.5°C but not 39°C (Fig. 1A), increased C4da-evoked rolling and shifted its stimulus-response curve (Fig. 1B-C), while a separate dry-hard-agar assay found increased nociceptor-elicited crawling speed during the first second (Fig. 4C-D). Fig. 1C reports groups of 56–116 larvae per intensity point; other sample sizes are panel-specific.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: animal behavioral and physiological study; no participant-level predictive model
sources.ограничения: The article combines separate behavior, electrophysiology, and calcium-imaging assays; it does not establish that all readouts came from the same animals. A08n responses are electrophysiological spikelets/depolarizations in opened, pinned larval preparations with intact PNS/CNS; Cho calcium imaging measures mechanosensory Cho activity, not C4da nociceptor calcium. Optogenetic C4da activation is distinct from mechanical touch, and rolling/crawling are distinct behavioral endpoints. Assay-specific sample sizes are reported rather than a pooled study-wide N. The study measures nociceptive processing and protective behavior; it does not measure subjective pain, human ECAP, SCS, or clinical outcomes.

evidence.sample_size: Assay-specific Ns are shown in figure panels; Fig. 1C uses groups of 56–116 larvae per stimulus-intensity point. No pooled study-wide N is reported.
evidence.target_label: Graded optogenetic C4da nociceptor stimulation and thermal-evoked escape; gentle mechanosensory touch/Cho input modulates A08n electrophysiology, while rolling and crawling are measured in separate behavioral assays.

sources.авторы: Ken Honjo; W. Daniel Tracey Jr.
sources.модальность: Thermal nociception behavior, optogenetic Class IV nociceptor activation, and heat-evoked GCaMP6m calcium imaging at nociceptor axon terminals
sources.задача: Test how Highwire and downstream BMP signaling regulate Drosophila larval nociceptor sensitivity and nocifensive behavior.
sources.метод: Nociceptor-specific hiw and BMP-pathway genetic manipulations; 39 C and 46 C thermal-probe nocifensive escape assays; ChR2 optogenetic assays; local thermal-ramp imaging of terminal GCaMP6m; pMad immunostaining. Imaging, molecular reporters and behavioral endpoints are distinct measures.
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster third-instar larval cohorts; separate behavior, calcium-imaging, immunostaining and morphology assays. Numerical figure data are supplied in PLOS Supporting Information S1 Dataset (DOI 10.1371/journal.pgen.1007464.s007).
sources.производительность: Behavior: 46 C probe measured latency to a completed 360-degree nocifensive escape roll (NEL; stimulation cutoff 11 s); 39 C probe used for hypersensitivity; optogenetic ChR2 assays used 3.8 klux or 76 klux in the 24-hour induction arm. Fig. 6: local heat-ramp stimulation evoked terminal GCaMP6m DeltaF/F0; control signal rose from about 37 C, peaked near 43 C and returned to baseline near 47 C, while tkvQD signal was increased across 36-50 C (n=17 control, n=19 tkvQD). These are separate animal preparations/readouts. pMad staining reports BMP pathway activation and is not neural activity.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: animal behavioral and physiological experiments; no participant-level predictive model
sources.ограничения: GCaMP6m is an optical calcium reporter, not electrophysiology or direct spike counting; pMad is a BMP-pathway marker, not neural activity. Behavioral NEL/rolling is a larval nocifensive endpoint and does not establish subjective pain. Thermal, optogenetic, calcium, pMad and morphology assays use distinct cohorts; no pooled study-wide N is stated. No human/clinical/SCS evidence or validated animal-to-human transfer.

sources.издание: Neuromodulation: Technology at the Neural Interface 28(7 Suppl), S209, ID 1907193; NANS 2025 poster UC202505767EN
sources.модальность: Prospective registry data; clinical pain outcome; predictive modeling
sources.задача: Predict six-month SCS responder status from patient baseline characteristics in the Product Surveillance Registry.
sources.метод: Prospective Product Surveillance Registry cohort. Responder: reduction of at least 2 points on a 0-10 pain score at six months versus baseline. Poster reports an 80/20 training/test split, five repeated five-fold cross-validation on the training set, and penalized logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost. The abstract/poster do not establish patient-level split implementation, the final model-specific denominator, linkage details, or external-cohort validation.
sources.датасет: Medtronic Product Surveillance Registry; 721 back and/or leg pain patients enrolled August 2012 through October 2023 were included in the analysis. Individual-level dataset access is not established.
sources.производительность: Poster Table 2, OCR checked: Elastic Net accuracy/sensitivity/specificity/precision/F1 0.680/0.862/0.354/0.704/0.775; random forest 0.691/0.940/0.246/0.690/0.796; XGBoost 0.685/0.819/0.446/0.725/0.769. These are author-reported poster metrics, not independently reproduced or externally validated.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_reported
sources.ограничения: Conference abstract and poster only. The poster prose says 274/363 combined-pain patients responded; its Table 1 instead lists 267 responders and 96 nonresponders (total 363), and the publisher abstract also says 267/363 (74%). Preserve the discrepancy; do not treat 274 as confirmed. Publisher page currently returns 403 to direct fetch. No full methods, patient-level data/linkage, exact split unit, or external validation were established. This is a clinical outcome prediction study; no ECAP predictor or neural recording is stated.

validation.notes: Primary publisher abstract and Medtronic/NANS author poster checked. Publisher abstract and poster Table 1 report 267/363 combined back-and-leg-pain responders (74%); poster prose says 274/363. Poster Table 1 also lists 96 nonresponders, summing with 267 to 363. Discrepancy retained without correction. Dataset includes 721 registry patients. No full methods or patient-level data were available; the abstract/poster do not specify patient-level split assignment or external validation. No ECAP predictor is stated.
