sources.название: Cascades and convergence: Dynamic signal flow in a synapse-level brain network
sources.авторы: Richard F. Betzel; Maria Grazia Puxeddu; Caio Seguin; Bratislav Misic
sources.модальность: Directed, weighted synapse-level connectome; stochastic spreading/cascade simulations
sources.задача: Model modality-specific, cooperative, and competitive sensory signal cascades and their overlap/convergence in an adult Drosophila connectome; not a nociception or clinical prediction task.
sources.метод: Three-state stochastic cascade model (active/inactive/refractory), independent Bernoulli transmission at synaptic contacts; main-text p_transmission=0.01 and N_seed=16; repeated simulations and derived activation, overlap, entropy, and cooperative speed-up measures.
sources.датасет: FlyWire FAFB adult female connectome, version v783; postprocessed data at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18555170.
sources.производительность: Not an outcome-prediction benchmark; reports model-derived network dynamics and statistics, not clinical or behavioral performance metrics.
sources.кросс_субъект: No cross-subject evaluation: analysis uses one adult female connectome.
sources.ограничения: Single reconstructed adult female fly connectome; abstract model of sensory-activity propagation; results generate experimental hypotheses. No nociception labels, protective-behavior endpoint, human pain, ECAP, SCS outcome, cross-subject validation, or LIF equivalence is established.

provenance.import_source: PLOS Complex Systems primary full text
provenance.query_or_seed: OpenAlex S775 citing works page 2 (records 21-40), DOI 10.1371/journal.pcsy.0000091; primary PLOS full text

evidence.population: One adult female FAFB connectome (FlyWire v783); simulations on the reconstructed network, not a sampled cohort.
evidence.sample_size: One reconstructed adult female connectome; 1000 independent stochastic runs per described experiment/statistic where reported.
evidence.target_label: No pain, nociception, behavior, ECAP, or SCS labels; simulated sensory-neural activation profiles only.

validation.notes: Primary PLOS full text checked: abstract, data availability, Results, Materials and methods. This is an analogue for connectome-constrained stochastic sensory cascades only; it does not establish nociception or clinical outcomes, or equivalence to leaky integrate-and-fire models.

sources.название: Balboa Binds to Pickpocket In Vivo and Is Required for Mechanical Nociception in Drosophila Larvae
sources.авторы: Stephanie E. Mauthner; Richard Y. Hwang; Amanda H. Lewis; Qi Xiao; Asako Tsubouchi; Yu Wang; Ken Honjo; J. H. Pate Skene; Jorg Grandl; W. Daniel Tracey Jr.
sources.модальность: Larval 30/50 mN von Frey-evoked rolling, ChR2-evoked behavior, Class IV/Class I RNA expression, GFP localization and reconstitution, heterologous cell mechanocurrent assays
sources.задача: Test whether Balboa/PPK26 and PPK contribute to larval mechanical nociception and interact in vivo.
sources.метод: Class IV-specific RNAi screen and larval von Frey behavior; microarray from laser-captured Class IV/Class I neurons; ChR2 behavioral control; GFP localization/reconstitution; heterologous HEK293t and S2R+ current assays. Main manuscript checked; supplementary protocols were not inspected.
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster larval experimental cohorts; Fig. 1D mechanical and Fig. 1E optogenetic behavioral groups are distinct.
sources.производительность: Fig. 1D at 30 mN: nocifensive response 67% (n=67) and 59% (n=64) in two controls versus 21% (n=62) with Class IV balboa-RNAi. Fig. 1E ChR2 response 84% (n=111) control versus 78% (n=113) knockdown, p=0.31. Primary screen used 50 mN. Heterologous Balboa/PPK expression yielded no mechanically evoked currents above background.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: larval experiment; no cross-subject predictive model
sources.ограничения: The result is larval nocifensive behavior, not subjective pain. GFP localization and protein interaction are not stimulus-evoked neural recordings. No mechanosensitive current was observed on Balboa/PPK coexpression in tested heterologous cells; an accessory factor remains possible. Main author manuscript checked; supplemental methods were not inspected. Sex and a pooled study-wide N were not reported in the checked passages. No human, ECAP, SCS or transfer validation.

evidence.sample_size: Fig. 1D mechanical groups n=67, 64, 62; Fig. 1E ChR2 groups n=111, 113. No pooled study-wide N.

validation.notes: Checked PubMed PMID 25454784 and PMC author manuscript NIHMS636619 through official NCBI BioC full-text route. No subjective pain or human transfer claim.

sources.задача: Test dPiezo contribution to larval mechanical nociception and mechanically activated currents in ppk-positive neurons.
sources.метод: Dpiezo knockout, ppk-cell knockdown and rescue; von Frey-evoked rolling; heat/gentle-touch controls; dissociated ppk-positive larval neuron cell-attached recordings under pipette suction.
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster third-instar larval behavior cohorts and separate dissociated ppk-positive neuron recordings.
sources.производительность: Fig. 1b compares force-response curves in 40 larvae across four experiments. Fig. 1e uses >85 larvae at 45 mN; Fig. 1f heat control n=60; Fig. 1g gentle-touch n>150. Fig. 3b cell-attached currents use 12 wild-type and 13 dpiezo-KO isolated neurons under negative pressure (0 to -60 mmHg). The cell and larval denominators are not interchangeable.

sources.ограничения: Cell-attached currents were recorded from dissociated larval ppk-positive neurons under pipette suction, not in-vivo neural responses to von Frey stimulation. sources.название: A novel thermosensitive escape behavior in Drosophila larvae
sources.авторы: Matthew Oswald; Beata Rymarczyk; Alastair Chatters; Sean T. Sweeney
sources.модальность: Temperature-calibrated heated-water droplet and direct immersion; visual larval head-thrash and corkscrew-roll behavior; painless mutant and Class IV TeTxLC silencing
sources.задача: Describe and calibrate a warm-water-triggered larval escape assay and examine dependence on painless and Class IV sensory neurons.
sources.метод: Third-instar larvae in a 30 microliter water droplet heated on a 70 C hotplate, with droplet temperature measured by thermocouple; separate direct-immersion fixed-temperature assay; painless mutant and Class IV neuron TeTxLC comparison.
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster third-instar larval behavioral cohorts; Fig. 1C genotype comparison and Fig. 1D direct-immersion temperature-response groups are separate.
sources.производительность: Fig. 1A/C: wild-type larval lateral head thrash then corkscrew roll at about 29 C water temperature; painless mutant and Class IV TeTxLC groups respond at about 33-34 C. Fig. 1D direct immersion used fresh larvae, n=100 per water temperature. The 70 C value is hotplate setting, not larval exposure temperature.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: behavioral assay, no predictive model or cross-subject split
sources.ограничения: 29 C warm-water escape is distinct from a focal hot-needle assay around 42 C; tissue damage and subjective pain were not measured. Author interpretation of nociception is not a direct measure of noxious tissue injury. No stimulus-evoked neural recording, human participants, ECAP, SCS or transfer validation. Fig. 1D n=100 per temperature is not a longitudinal or human sample; larval sex not reported.

provenance.query_or_seed: 10.4161/fly.5.4.17810 from independent 28-work bibliography; PubMed and PMC primary text

evidence.population: Third-instar larvae; genotype and direct-immersion groups separate; sex not reported.
evidence.sample_size: Fig. 1D: fresh larvae n=100 for each water temperature; Fig. 1C denominators are shown within its genotype bars, no pooled study-wide N.
evidence.target_label: Lateral head thrash followed by corkscrew roll after measured warm-water exposure

validation.notes: Full PMC article and PubMed identity checked. Fig. 1A-D separates thermocouple-measured droplet water from 70 C hotplate setting and shows warm-water escape at about 29 C. This is a behavioral temperature-avoidance assay, not direct tissue-damage, neural-spike or subjective-pain measurement.

sources.название: Nociceptor-Enriched Genes Required for Normal Thermal Nociception
sources.авторы: Ken Honjo; Stephanie E. Mauthner; Yu Wang; J. H. Pate Skene; W. Daniel Tracey Jr.
sources.модальность: Class IV/Class I neuron microarray, nociceptor-specific RNAi, larval thermal-probe nocifensive behavior, dendrite-morphology imaging
sources.задача: Identify larval nociceptor-enriched genes required for normal thermal nocifensive responses.
sources.метод: Laser-capture Class IV and Class I neuron microarray; 419 UAS-RNAi lines targeting 229 of 275 enriched genes; Class IV ppk1.9-GAL4/UAS-dicer2 knockdown and separate 46 C insensitivity and 42 C hypersensitivity thermal-probe assays; morphology checks.
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster wandering third-instar larval RNAi and behavioral cohorts; Class IV/Class I neuron expression samples. Animal-level sample sizes differ by assay and genotype.
sources.производительность: 278 probes corresponded to 275 Class IV-enriched genes (>2-fold, p<0.05). Of 419 RNAi lines targeting 229 genes, 16 lines targeting 14 genes had retested insensitive 46 C responses and 24 lines targeting 22 genes had retested hypersensitive 42 C responses. These are genes/lines, not larval sample sizes or predictive accuracies.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: genetic screen and larval assay, not a participant-level predictive model
sources.ограничения: Thermal nocifensive escape is larval behavior, not subjective pain. Microarray and dendrite morphology do not measure stimulus-evoked neural firing; no direct neural recording. RNAi can yield false negatives from incomplete knockdown and off-target false positives; authors estimate up to 40% ineffective major-collection strains and about 6% off-target effects in comparator tissues. No pooled animal N, human ECAP/SCS outcomes or validated transfer.

provenance.query_or_seed: S777 References #14; 10.1016/j.celrep.2016.06.003; official PMC author manuscript and PubMed

evidence.population: F1 wandering third-instar larvae for RNAi/thermal behavior; Class IV/Class I neurons for separate expression assay. Larval sex not reported.
evidence.sample_size: 419 RNAi lines targeted 229 genes; 16 lines/14 genes insensitive and 24 lines/22 genes hypersensitive after retest. These are not animal Ns; no pooled larval N reported.
evidence.target_label: Larval nocifensive response latency to 46 C or 42 C thermal probe under Class IV neuron RNAi

validation.notes: Checked full NIH author manuscript through official NCBI BioC endpoint and PubMed PMID 27346357. Results, Fig. 1-4 and Methods distinguish 42/46 C behavior, Class IV/Class I microarray and morphology. RNAi false-negative/off-target cautions retained; no evoked neural recording or subjective-pain measure.

sources.модальность: Thermal-probe and von Frey larval rolling behavior, mechanically evoked Class IV ddaC GCaMP3 optical neural recording in filleted larvae, SK genetic screen/rescue and protein localization
sources.задача: Test whether the SK potassium channel regulates larval nociceptor excitability and nocifensive behavior.
sources.метод: SK RNAi and null mutation with BAC/Class IV rescue; 42 C thermal response latency and 30 mN von Frey rolling; separate filleted-larva Class IV ddaC GCaMP3 imaging with 50 mN force; SK protein immunolocalization.

sources.ограничения: Behavior, filleted-larva optical calcium, and SK protein localization are distinct measurements; GCaMP3 is not direct electrophysiology or subjective pain. sources.название: Thermosensory and nonthermosensory isoforms of Drosophila melanogaster TRPA1 reveal heat-sensor domains of a thermoTRP channel
sources.авторы: Lixian Zhong; Andrew Bellemer; Haidun Yan; Ken Honjo; Jessica Robertson; Richard Y. Hwang; Geoffrey S. Pitt; W. Daniel Tracey
sources.модальность: 46 C thermal probe and 30 mN von Frey larval nocifensive escape behavior; separate gentle-touch control; dTRPA1 genetic perturbation, expression mapping and S2R+ cell calcium imaging/patch-clamp
sources.задача: Test the role of dTRPA1 isoforms in larval thermal and mechanical nocifensive responses and heterologous temperature sensitivity.
sources.метод: Mutant, BAC rescue and mdIV-specific RNAi/isoform rescue; assay-specific larval escape latency and response to calibrated von Frey force; reporter expression; separate transfected S2R+ GCaMP and patch-clamp.
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster wandering third-instar larvae in distinct behavioral cohorts; transfected S2R+ cells in separate heterologous assays.
sources.производительность: Fig. 1B-F thermal 46 C latency: WT n=115, W903* mutant n=149; Fig. 1G mechanical 30 mN response: WT n=120, W903* mutant n=97. Fig. 2A-D reports thermal rescue and mdIV RNAi; Fig. 2E-F reports mechanical rescue and mdIV RNAi. Fig. 7C S2R+ patch-clamp has 15 and 12 cells for the two isoforms under heat; these are not larval neural recordings.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: animal genetics and cell physiology, no participant-level predictive model
sources.ограничения: Larval nocifensive escape is behavior, not subjective pain. Reporter expression is not activity. S2R+ calcium and patch-clamp are transfected-cell assays, not in-vivo nociceptor recordings. Distinct cohorts and stimuli cannot be pooled. dTRPA1 is required for behavior, but direct mechanical transduction is not demonstrated; no human ECAP/SCS or clinical outcome.

sources.название: NeuroGraphBench: Interacting with Drosophila Connectomes at Scale for Exploring the Functional Logic of Neural Circuits
sources.авторы: Aurel A. Lazar; Shashwat Shukla; Yiyin Zhou
sources.модальность: Adult Drosophila connectome morphology/retinotopy, simulated visual looming trajectories, and modeled Giant Fiber threshold output; no live neural or behavior recordings.
sources.задача: Build an executable, connectome-grounded LPLC2 to Giant Fiber circuit model that distinguishes direct-hit and near-miss looming trajectories in silico.
sources.метод: NeuroGraphBench morphology primitives on OpticLobe/Hemibrain/FlyWire connectomes; retinotopic LPLC2 pathway abstraction; modeled differential GF dendritic readout, divisive-normalization peak detector, and ideal integrate-and-fire threshold output.
sources.датасет: Published OpticLobe, Hemibrain and FlyWire Drosophila connectome datasets are referenced for morphology; manuscript links no release or repository of NeuroGraphBench model code or derived study artifacts.
sources.производительность: Fig. 5 modeled looming at v=0.20 m/s: with GF threshold 0.02, direct hit produces a simulated escape spike at 40 degrees angular diameter; near miss with b=5.0 mm stays below threshold. Fig. 6 explores modeled speed/threshold tradeoffs; no in-vivo accuracy or clinical metric.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no participant/animal prediction split in this in-silico circuit demonstration
sources.ограничения: Unreviewed bioRxiv v1. The model predicts an escape spike, not observed fly escape or in-vivo GF activity; authors say GF dependence on looming elevation and non-colliding trajectories remains untested. No model-code/data deposit is linked in the manuscript. No nociception, subjective pain, ECAP, SCS, or human transfer.

sources.название: Pseudo-labeling based adaptations of pain domain classifiers
sources.авторы: Tobias B. Ricken; Sascha Gruss; Steffen Walter; Friedhelm Schwenker
sources.модальность: ECG, EDA, EMG; experimental electric and thermal stimuli

sources.авторы: Tobias B. Ricken; Peter Bellmann; Steffen Walter; Friedhelm Schwenker
sources.модальность: ECG, EDA and three EMG muscles (COR, TRA, ZYG); experimental electrical and thermal stimuli
sources.задача: Classify no-pain baseline versus individually calibrated pain-tolerance stimulation after transfer from real phasic to real tonic X-ITE events.
sources.метод: Random Forest trained on real phasic events; use phasic class prototypes and distance metrics to select one of 14 tonic segments for event classification; participant LOSO-CV.
sources.датасет: X-ITE source corpus 134 healthy participants (67 female, 67 male); this study analyzed 125, excluding nine with data errors; underlying raw dataset reuse permission not established by this article.
sources.производительность: Publisher abstract: electric TRA mean accuracy 68.0% versus naive 66.0%; thermal EDA 59.6% versus naive 53.2%; internal participant LOSO, no external cohort.
sources.кросс_субъект: Participant LOSO-CV; held-out subject evaluates classifier trained on remaining participants. Each tonic event yields 14 segments; selected segment is a within-event input, not an independent subject.
sources.ограничения: Same X-ITE lineage as S818 and S817, not independent replication. No synthetic source or clinical patient outcome. Nine excluded for unspecified data errors; exact identities unavailable. Internal LOSO does not establish external validation. Publisher data-availability statement says not applicable and does not grant raw dataset reuse.

sources.название: Simulation insights on the compound action potential in multifascicular nerves
sources.авторы: Joseph James Tharayil; Ciro Zinno; Filippo Agnesi; Bryn Lloyd; Silvia Farcito; Antonino Cassara; Niels Kuster; Michael Reimann; Silvestro Micera; Esra Neufeld
sources.модальность: Измеренный vagal eCAP; электрофизиологическая симуляция и FEM
sources.задача: Моделировать наблюдаемый compound action potential в многофасцикулярном блуждающем нерве и оценить чувствительность сигнала к рекрутированию волокон и геометрии электродов
sources.метод: Расширенная теорема взаимности; FEM-поле и sensitivity/exposure function; SFAP из NEURON-модели волокон; semi-analytic суммирование по фасцикулам с кривыми рекрутирования; сравнение с in-vivo записью у свиней
sources.датасет: Записи eCAP у пяти здоровых взрослых самцов Göttingen minipig; модель геометрии построена по гистологическому срезу блуждающего нерва; открытые ссылки на FEM, код и экспериментальные данные приведены издателем
sources.производительность: Качественно воспроизведены основные фазы и сопоставимая амплитуда in-vivo eCAP; не воспроизведён второй отрицательный дефлекс около 5 ms и различие амплитуд между стимулом 100 μA и более сильными стимулами. Вклад фасцикул и амплитуда eCAP зависят от рекрутирования и геометрии; формальная оценка обобщения не заявлена
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: физическая модель сигнала сопоставлена с экспериментальными записями у животных; разбиение по животным и прогноз для held-out животных не заявлены
sources.ограничения: Периферический блуждающий нерв, не центральный коннектом и не спинной мозг; пять животных, без проверки межвидового переноса модели на человека; eCAP не является субъективной болью или клиническим исходом. Модель предполагает одновременное срабатывание рекрутированных волокон и упрощённую/гистологическую геометрию; полный сигнал не воспроизведён.

sources.название: Early outcomes with a flexible ECAP based closed loop using multiplexed spinal cord stimulation waveforms—single-arm study with in-clinic randomized crossover testing
sources.авторы: Vahid Mohabbati; Richard Sullivan; James Yu; Peter Georgius; Charles D. Brooker; Malgorzata Siorek; Nancy L. McClelland; Filippo Coletti; Xiaoxi Sun; Abi Franke; Marc A. Russo
sources.модальность: Проспективное многоцентровое клиническое исследование ECAP-controlled closed-loop SCS; внутриклиническое перекрёстное сравнение CL/OL и отдельные пациентские исходы боли VAS
sources.задача: Оценить снижение ощущения overstimulation при ECAP-контролируемом closed-loop SCS по сравнению с open-loop во время внутриклинических проб и описать 3-месячные исходы боли
sources.метод: Проспективное одно-групповое исследование в 7 центрах Австралии; до 24 месяцев открытого наблюдения. На визитах проводилось рандомизированное слепое внутриклиническое перекрёстное тестирование порядка CL/OL; рандомизация относилась только к последовательности тестовых периодов, а хроническое лечение и оценка боли не были рандомизированы между группами. Первичная конечная точка — доля участников с меньшим средним баллом overstimulation при CL, n=28; боль VAS — вторичная описательная конечная точка, для вторичных целей не планировались проверки гипотез.
sources.датасет: Исследование NCT05177354: 94 включены, 75 прошли SCS trial, 60 имплантированы, 54 завершили 3-месячный визит. Набор первичной конечной точки CL/OL n=28; исход overall low-back/leg VAS n=51, low-back n=43, leg n=41; upper-limb n=3. Публикация и ClinicalTrials.gov дают агрегированные результаты; отдельный открытый participant-level набор не выявлен.
sources.производительность: Первичная точка: 25/28 участников имели меньший средний overstimulation score при CL, чем при OL (89,3%; p<0,001 в статье). Через 3 месяца ≥50% снижения overall pain VAS было у 44/51 участников (86,3%), low-back VAS у 38/43 (88,4%), leg VAS у 30/41 (73,2%); для upper-limb 3/3. Болевые исходы вторичные, описательные, без проверки гипотез. Это не точность предиктора ECAP и не проверка индивидуального прогноза ответа.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: прогностическая модель и межсубъектное тестирование не проводились
sources.ограничения: Болевые исходы открытого одно-группового наблюдения, без контрольной группы для долгосрочного лечения и без проверки гипотез для вторичных исходов; опубликованы лишь ранние результаты до 3 месяцев. Внутриклиническая рандомизация касается только порядка CL/OL тестовых периодов, а не назначения терапии на длительный срок. ECAP используется как физиологический сигнал обратной связи для управления стимуляцией, не как непосредственная мера боли и не как проверенный самостоятельный предиктор обезболивания. Разбиение по пациентам, межсубъектная/внешняя валидация, калибровка, неопределённость предиктора не применимы: модели предсказания нет. Исследование спонсировала Medtronic; спонсор участвовал в дизайне, проведении, сборе, управлении, анализе и интерпретации данных; несколько авторов являются сотрудниками компании. Индивидуальные данные отдельным открытым файлом не обнаружены; registry results агрегированы.

Разбиение по пациентам, межсубъектная/внешняя валидация, калибровка, неопределённость предиктора не применимы: модели предсказания нет. Исследование спонсировала Medtronic; спонсор участвовал в дизайне, проведении, сборе, управлении, анализе и интерпретации данных; несколько авторов являются сотрудниками компании. Индивидуальные данные отдельным открытым файлом не обнаружены; registry results агрегированы.

sources.метод: Local thermal-ramp stimulation of the larval body wall; Goro-neuron imaging is a neural assay, while thermal-probe nocifensive behavior is assayed separately. GCaMP6m imaging recorded Goro-neuron calcium signals during local thermal ramps. CCKLR-17D1 mutant and RNAi conditions showed sensitized signal increases in the noxious range (40-50 °C); the ramp preparation kept peak CNS temperature near 27 °C. This is a calcium signal, not electrophysiology. Separate larval thermal-probe assays measured response latency/rolling, including response to a 42 °C probe. Those behavioral cohorts are distinct from Goro calcium imaging.
sources.ограничения: Specific calcium ramp cohorts are reported (including n=12 CNS temperature measurements); no single combined sample size or cross-subject predictive validation is reported.

Spectral-regression or PCA representations are learned from unlabelled neutral/apex-expression Cohn-Kanade images and transferred to labelled UNBC-McMaster target data; two-level late fusion uses RBF support-vector regressors, and three models trained on independently sampled balanced sets are averaged.

sources.название: Absence of paresthesia during high-rate spinal cord stimulation reveals importance of synchrony for sensations evoked by electrical stimulation
sources.авторы: Boriss Sagalajev; Tianhe Zhang; Nooshin Abdollahi; Noosha Yousefpour; Laura Medlock; Dhekra Al-Basha; Alfredo Ribeiro-da-Silva; Rosana Esteller; Stéphanie Ratté; Steven A. Prescott
sources.модальность: Epidural ECAP recordings; animal neural recordings and calcium imaging; computational modeling; participant-reported paresthesia
sources.задача: Mechanistic comparison of stimulation-frequency effects on synchronous neural recruitment (ECAP) and perceived paresthesia; one-patient acute observation is not a pain-treatment outcome study.
sources.метод: A single chronic-pain patient undergoing an SCS trial received symmetric biphasic stimulation at 150 Hz and 1 kHz with the same 9.6 mA amplitude and pulse width printed as 50 μs/phase. Bipolar contacts were 8 mm apart; each condition lasted at least 10 min. The article also reports acute pig and rat experiments and computational models.
sources.датасет: Human electrophysiology and animal electrophysiology/calcium-imaging data are available from the lead contact on reasonable request, not as a public participant-level dataset. Modeling code is publicly deposited at Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.10019046) and ModelDB (267768).
sources.производительность: Mechanistic study; no machine-learning prediction score or cross-validation result reported. In the single human observation, ECAP and paresthesia were detected at 150 Hz and neither at 1 kHz.
sources.кросс_субъект: No cross-participant validation: the human ECAP/paresthesia comparison is one participant.
sources.ограничения: Human evidence is one acute within-person SCS-trial observation; no longitudinal follow-up, patient-level ECAP-to-pain outcome, clinical efficacy estimate, held-out participant, or external validation. Data require a reasonable request. Do not equate ECAP with pain; observed percept is paresthesia. Animal and computational results do not expand the human sample.

sources.авторы: Jesus Gonzalez-Ferrer; Julian Lehrer; Bruno Alvarez-Esteban; Avelina Moreno-Ochando; Hunter E. Schweiger; Jinghui Geng; Luiz F. S. Eugenio dos Santos; Sebastian Hernandez; Francisco Reyes; Jess L. Sevetson; Aidan Schneider; Sofie R. Salama; Mircea Teodorescu; David Haussler; Mohammed A. Mostajo-Radji
sources.модальность: Внеклеточная электрофизиология: средняя форма потенциала действия, распределение межспайковых интервалов (ISI), автокоррелограмма (ACG); в статье также рассмотрена 3D-ACG.
sources.задача: Классификация типов нейронов и генеративный анализ внеклеточных электрофизиологических представлений; отдельный benchmark проверяет обучение на макаке и оценку на мыши.
sources.метод: Self-supervised pretraining и supervised fine-tuning в conditional convolutional joint autoencoders (cVAE), объединённых mixture-модулем; conditioning включает recording technology, species and brain region.
sources.датасет: Несколько исходных корпусов; межвидовой Fig. 5: Lisberger cerebellar cortex macaque source (668 labeled / 1152 total neurons) → полный Hull cerebellar cortex mouse test set (N=101; четыре общих cell types). Другие benchmarks включают Hausser mouse, Watson rat, Allen, IBL и DANDI datasets.
sources.производительность: Fig. 5: в единственном macaque→mouse transfer balanced accuracy HIPPIE=0.65 после cross-dataset pretraining (NEMO=0.72; baseline VAE=0.60); HIPPIE без pretraining=0.40. Hull test set N=101; по одной оценке на метод, без CV/error bars.
sources.кросс_субъект: Cross-dataset, cross-species evaluation: source Lisberger macaque, full target Hull mouse dataset; Fig. 5 не сообщает animal-level split внутри target data и не является human validation.
sources.ограничения: Один межвидовой transfer в одном направлении и без CV/error bars; Fig. 5 — классификация neuronal cell types, а не pain outcome. В обучении нет labeled human neuronal data; авторы говорят, что clinical potential rests on an assumption of cross-species transferability that is not guaranteed at human scale. Нет теста Drosophila/connectome→human transfer, causal invariants, ECAP, SCS or clinical pain outcome.

sources.название: Subcallosal Cingulate structural connectivity as biomarker for chronic low back pain
sources.авторы: Evangelia Tsolaki; Wenxin Wei; Michael Ward; Ausaf Bari; Nader Pouratian
sources.модальность: Baseline diffusion MRI probabilistic tractography of subcallosal cingulate connectivity; patient-reported VAS after an SCS trial
sources.задача: Examine whether baseline subcallosal cingulate structural connectivity is associated with short-term SCS-trial pain response in chronic low back pain.
sources.метод: Eight patients underwent baseline diffusion MRI before a percutaneous SCS trial. VAS was assessed before and 15 days after the trial; response was >50% VAS reduction. The authors compared SCC connectivity with binary response using a general linear model, continuous VAS change using Pearson correlation, and VAS percentage change using multiple regression including baseline HAMD. No predictive train/test split or independent validation is described.
sources.датасет: Eight chronic-low-back-pain patients (six UCLA, two UTSW); individual imaging data and analysis code are not publicly deposited in the checked source; data are available on reasonable request to the author.
sources.производительность: No held-out prediction performance is reported. Within the eight-person cohort, the authors report SCC connectivity associations with SCS-trial response and VAS change; these association statistics do not establish validated clinical prediction.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no train/test evaluation or independent patient cohort was conducted
sources.ограничения: Non-peer-reviewed preprint with eight patients and 15-day trial response only. No ECAP predictor, long-term implanted-SCS outcome, held-out predictive evaluation, or public patient-level imaging dataset. Authors reserve reuse rights for preprint material; underlying data are available only on reasonable request. Do not merge this cohort with other SCS imaging studies without an explicit identity bridge.

sources.название: Low FoxO expression in Drosophila somatosensory neurons protects dendrite growth under nutrient restriction
sources.авторы: Amy R Poe; Yineng Xu; Christine Zhang; Joyce Lei; Kailyn Li; David Labib; Chun Han
sources.модальность: Thermal heat-probe stimulation; larval whole-animal rolling behavior; C4da sensory-neuron dendrite morphology imaging
sources.задача: Test how nutrient restriction and FoxO affect C4da sensory-neuron dendrite growth and larval heat-probe-evoked rolling behavior.
sources.метод: Wandering third-instar Drosophila larvae were reared on high-yeast (8%) or low-yeast (1%) food. C4da dendrite morphology was imaged and quantified in separate morphology experiments. In the behavior assay, a temperature-controlled probe touched body segment A4; each larva was tested once and latency was measured to a complete 360-degree roll. Figure 6 compares responder and fast-responder proportions across temperatures, including FoxO overexpression groups. This is a behavioral nociceptive-response measure; the paper reports no stimulus-evoked neural activity recording. Do not merge behavior with dendrite morphology or interpret either as subjective pain.
sources.датасет: The article states that all generated or analyzed data are in the manuscript and supporting files; Figure 6 source data 1 contains behavior analyses. No independent cohort or predictive dataset is described.
sources.производительность: Not applicable: this biological study reports dendrite and behavioral outcomes, not predictive-model performance. Figure 6 reports responder proportions, response latency, and standard error across three repeats.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no predictive model, train/test split, or cross-subject evaluation was conducted
sources.ограничения: Drosophila larval thermal probe and rolling behavior only. Figure 6 behavioral responders are measured in whole larvae; neuronal morphology is a separate endpoint. sources.название: The Drosophila ortholog of vertebrate TRPA1 regulates thermotaxis
sources.авторы: Mark Rosenzweig; Karen M Brennan; Timothy D Tayler; Paul O Phelps; Ardem Patapoutian; Paul A Garrity
sources.модальность: Larval thermal-gradient behavior (thermotaxis) and high-temperature probe-evoked curling; separate dTRPA1 immunostaining localizes protein in brain neurons and corpus cardiacum.
sources.задача: Test the role of dTRPA1 in Drosophila larval thermotaxis and distinguish thermal-gradient behavior from high-temperature probe-evoked nociceptive behavior.
sources.метод: The study uses dsRNA knockdown of dTrpA1 and other TRP genes, then tests larval thermal preference on a temperature gradient. Separate behavioral tests expose crawling third-instar larvae to a 55-57 degrees C probe and record curling/withdrawal; dTrpA1-Gal4-driven TeTxLC or Hid tests dTRPA1-expressing-cell contributions. The article separately uses dTRPA1 immunostaining; it does not report stimulus-evoked neural activity recording.
sources.датасет: Study-specific Drosophila larval behavioral assays and genetic manipulations reported in Figures 1-4; no external benchmark dataset is identified in the article.
sources.производительность: Not applicable: the article reports biological behavioral outcomes, not predictive-model performance. Figure 3C reports time from hot-probe contact to curling, and Figure 4H reports probe-response comparators.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no predictive model, train/test split, or cross-subject evaluation was conducted
sources.ограничения: Drosophila larval thermal-gradient and hot-probe behaviors only. The matrix-relevant negative result is specific to dTrpA1 RNAi larvae in the approximately 55 degrees C probe assay (Figures 3B-C); it does not establish that dTRPA1 is irrelevant to all nociception. Thermotaxis and high-temperature probe response are distinct behavioral endpoints. No subjective pain or human clinical outcome is measured; immunostaining is not stimulus-evoked neural activity recording.

sources.название: Heat-off responses of epidermal cells sensitize Drosophila larvae to noxious inputs
sources.авторы: Jiro Yoshino; Avery Chiu; Takeshi Morita; Chang Yin; Federico M Tenedini; Takaaki Sokabe; Kazuo Emoto; Jay Z Parrish
sources.издание: bioRxiv preprint v1, posted 2025-06-03; no peer-reviewed journal Version of Record confirmed on checked owner routes
sources.модальность: Calibrated larval heat-probe and von Frey rolling behavior; separate epidermal-cell GCaMP6s calcium imaging in semi-intact fillets and dissociated cells; optogenetic epidermal/C4da behavioral controls.
sources.задача: Test whether larval epidermal heat-off calcium responses and Stim/Orai signaling contribute to sensitization of protective rolling after thermal stimulation.
sources.метод: Third-instar larvae received a 41.5 °C dorsal probe, a prior 25–45 °C Peltier heat step, or a 50 mN von Frey stimulus in distinct behavioral comparisons. R38F11-driven GCaMP6s measured epidermal calcium during ~20–45 °C saline ramps in separate dissected fillets; Stim/Orai perturbations and CsChrimson tests probe mechanism. Figure 1 caption states 30 s recovery after Peltier heat whereas Methods paragraphs P26–P27 state 10 s; the interval is unresolved.
sources.датасет: Study-specific third-instar Drosophila larvae; intact-animal rolling cohorts and semi-intact/dissociated epidermal calcium preparations are distinct. The v1 preprint reports figure data, but the checked text has no public raw-data repository or data-availability statement.
sources.производительность: Not applicable to a predictive model. Primary Results P10/Figure 2D reports epidermal heat-off GCaMP6s ΔF/F0 82.34 ± 8.84% versus 0.49 ± 0.47% for 20 °C fluid-flow control (n=20 specimens per condition). Results P7/Figure 1E reports first versus second 41.5 °C probe rolling latency 8.79 ± 3.36 s versus 3.40 ± 2.12 s (n=38 larvae) in a separate behavior assay.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no predictive train/test or cross-animal generalization experiment
sources.ограничения: This is bioRxiv v1, not a confirmed peer-reviewed VOR. The calcium recording is epidermal R38F11-GCaMP6s, not direct C4da nociceptor activity; C4da appears in a separate optogenetic behavioral control. Figure 1 caption and Methods disagree on 30 s versus 10 s post-Peltier recovery. Figure-specific n values are not pooled into a study-wide sample size; exact Figure 1H condition-to-n mapping is unresolved. No subjective pain, human ECAP, SCS response, clinical outcome or cross-species validation is measured.

sources.название: Trust-gated synthetic EEG augmentation reduces performance drops when generalizing to new patients
sources.авторы: Daniel Choi; Cordelia Yip; Andrew Choi; Junho Park
sources.модальность: Resting-state EEG in PainMunich chronic-pain case/control cohort; separate BCI IV-2a motor-imagery EEG stress-test dataset.
sources.задача: Control the risk that synthetic EEG augmentation worsens subject-disjoint case/control or motor-imagery classification on held-out real people.
sources.метод: For each subject-disjoint fold, a conditional latent-diffusion generator is fit on real training subjects only; a separate geometry-aware teacher fit on real training windows filters synthetic candidates by label consistency and confidence quantile. A fail-closed selector injects accepted windows only if held-out validation AUROC beats a real-only model by margin 0.01. Five-fold participant-disjoint CV with five seeds compares paired augmentation and real-only runs.
sources.датасет: PainMunich resting-state EEG dataset 1: 189 people (101 chronic-pain cases, 88 healthy controls); a separate BCI Competition IV-2a motor-imagery dataset has 9 people. Publisher Data availability links PainMunich BIDS-EEG on OSF and BCI IV-2a portal, with original-provider terms applying. Author code is linked from the publisher Code availability section.
sources.производительность: PainMunich at 5% training-subject scarcity: ungated augmentation caused test AUROC decline >0.01 in 56% of paired runs, versus 24% with trust-gated augmentation at q=0.99; mean AUROC was comparable. BCI IV-2a at 25% scarcity: AUROC 0.679 versus 0.627 and harm rate 0.16 versus 0.44. These are within-paper subject-disjoint results, not external clinical validation or patient outcomes.
sources.кросс_субъект: Participant-disjoint train/validation/test in five-fold CV repeated over five seeds; scarcity subsamples only training subjects. Generator and teacher fit only real training subjects/windows per fold. PainMunich test labels are chronic-pain case/control, not pain intensity.
sources.ограничения: This is a partial NS-06 analogue: labelled real training plus synthetic augmentation under participant shift, not synthetic-only source transfer or unlabeled-target alignment. The PainMunich label distinguishes chronic-pain cases from controls, not pain intensity, subjective relief, treatment response or SCS/ECAP outcome. The BCI benchmark is a different motor-imagery task, not a separate chronic-pain cohort. Author-defined harm is ΔAUROC degradation, a model-performance safety proxy rather than patient harm. Dataset access follows original provider terms; reported CV does not establish clinical deployment generalization.

sources.ограничения: Partial pain-domain adaptation analogue. sources.название: An optimization framework for targeted spinal cord stimulation
sources.авторы: Ehsan Mirzakhalili; Evan R. Rogers; Scott F. Lempka
sources.модальность: Computational finite-element volume conductor and multicompartment spinal cord axon/cell models; no newly measured patient ECAP or pain data.
sources.задача: Optimize SCS electrode current fractions for modeled neural recruitment in regions of interest while limiting regions of avoidance.
sources.метод: Analytic Lagrange-multiplier formulation with smoothing approximations and numerical nonlinear-equation solution; single- and multi-objective Pareto optimization evaluated in a lower-thoracic FEM and axon/cell simulations. The FEM volume-conductor model is explicitly attributed to Anaya et al. 2020 (S766, reference 31).
sources.датасет: Literature-derived lower-thoracic FEM geometry with two eight-contact percutaneous SCS arrays and modeled dorsal-column axons/dorsal-horn cells; no participant-level dataset or linked clinical outcome.
sources.производительность: In simulations, simple ROI optimization resembled bipolar configurations; multi-objective Pareto solutions yielded nontrivial configurations and distinct modeled neural recruitment profiles. The publication reports no prospective patient outcome, pain-relief effect, or external ECAP validation for these optimized settings.
sources.кросс_субъект: Not applicable: no newly enrolled participants and no participant-level train/test split; individual tailoring is a proposed application, not validated here.
sources.ограничения: Computational SCS optimization prior art and a direct descendant of S766 geometry. Simulation recruitment and optimizer output are not measured ECAP, subjective pain intensity, analgesia or prospective clinical response. No participant-level external validation or reusable paired ECAP/outcome dataset is supplied.

sources.название: Cold sensing by a glutamate receptor drives avoidance behavior in Drosophila larvae
sources.авторы: L. Amanda Xu; Hyun-Joon Son; Xu Bai; Ruonan Li; Elizabeth A. Ronan; Gun-Ho Kim; Bing Ye
sources.модальность: Touchless localized thermal stimulation; larval head-avoidance behavior; aC3da-neuron GCaMP calcium imaging; genetic, RNAi and optogenetic perturbations; CHO-cell Fura-2 calcium imaging
sources.задача: Determine whether Drosophila larvae escape acute cold and identify head sensory neurons and molecular mechanisms required for cold-evoked avoidance.
sources.метод: Custom thermoelectric probe delivers non-contact cool (18°C) and cold (13°C) stimuli to head, midsection or tail during locomotion; quantify head avoidance; optogenetic inhibition/activation and mutant/RNAi perturbations; GCaMP calcium imaging of aC3da neurons; heterologous Clumsy expression and Fura-2 calcium imaging in CHO cells.
sources.датасет: Primary experimental observations and figure-level data in the article and supplements; no separate dataset accession identified in the checked article. Wild-type Canton-S head-avoidance cohorts: ambient n=100, 18°C n=109, 13°C n=71. Other assay sample sizes vary by genotype and figure; do not pool across assays.
sources.производительность: Not a predictive model; no predictive performance metric. Experimental outcomes are quantified as head-avoidance frequency and calcium responses, with figure-specific statistical tests and sample sizes.
sources.кросс_субъект: Not a prediction/generalization study; no held-out-larva or cross-subject validation split is reported.
sources.ограничения: The central behavioral endpoint is larval head withdrawal/turning away from localized cold (head avoidance), not the body-wall contraction (CT) reported in S839. Midsection avoidance was weak in non-contact conditions and tail responses were not notable. Larval avoidance and calcium activity do not establish subjective pain; CHO-cell expression is a heterologous assay, and no human pain, ECAP, SCS, or clinical transfer is evaluated. Figure Ns are assay-specific.

provenance.import_source: Primary bioRxiv preprint full text in PMC BioC; PubMed record used for bibliographic metadata and preprint status.
provenance.search_stream: Xu et al. DOI candidate review / Drosophila cold-response source reconciliation
provenance.query_or_seed: Exact DOI 10.1101/2025.10.05.680544; primary full text PMC12632497 and PubMed PMID 41279068; checked 2026-09-28

evidence.species: Drosophila melanogaster; heterologous CHO cells in molecular validation assay
evidence.population: Forward-locomoting mid-third-instar D. melanogaster larvae; separate dissociated larval-head calcium-imaging preparations; separate CHO-cell expression assays.
evidence.sample_size: Figure-specific. Fig. 1 head avoidance: wild-type Canton-S ambient n=100, 18°C n=109, 13°C n=71. Fig. 2 aC3da calcium imaging n=32 clusters per temperature; optogenetic head avoidance n=43 control and n=40 activation. Other genotype and imaging Ns are specified in figure legends and differ by assay; not a single pooled sample.

sources.модальность: FlyCircuit single-neuron morphologies, inferred synaptic connections and simulated LIF spikes/resting-state network dynamics; no live fly recording in the model comparison.
sources.задача: Construct a brain-wide fly neural network from registered single-neuron morphologies and simulate resting-state activity versus a connection-shuffled network.
sources.метод: Flysim predicts neurite polarity and putative connections from FlyCircuit single-neuron images, assigns single-compartment leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with conductance synapses, and compares reconstructed versus connection-shuffled resting-state simulations.

sources.ограничения: The input neurons were imaged from different brains and connections are computationally inferred from aligned morphology, not directly measured synapses of one animal. Model output is resting-state simulation compared with shuffled network, without in-vivo neural or behavioral validation in this study. sources.название: Differences in the critical dynamics underlying the human and fruit-fly connectome
sources.авторы: Géza Ódor; Gustavo Deco; Jeffrey Kelling
sources.модальность: Simulated Kuramoto oscillator dynamics on a Drosophila hemibrain graph and a separate human white-matter connectome graph.
sources.задача: Compare synchronization-transition behavior generated by the same mathematical model on fly and human structural network topologies.
sources.метод: Kuramoto phase-oscillator simulations on hemibrain v1.0.1 and KKI-18 human structural graph, with Erdos-Renyi graph controls, weighted coupling normalization and multiple random initial frequencies.
sources.датасет: Fly hemibrain v1.0.1: 21,662 nodes and 3,413,160 directed weighted edges before largest-component selection; simulations use 21,615 nodes and 3,410,247 edges. Human KKI-18 is a much coarser 804,092-node white-matter graph. These are distinct structural data products.
sources.производительность: The authors report a sharper, mean-field-like fly transition than the broader KKI-18 human model transition (Figs. 3-6); this is a model comparison, not out-of-species predictive performance.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: two distinct structural graphs are simulated separately; there is no held-out subject or learned fly-to-human transfer evaluation
sources.ограничения: The article compares separately simulated rest-state oscillator systems at different anatomical resolutions; it does not train a representation on fly data and transfer it to human neural recordings. No nociceptive perturbation, pain behavior, ECAP, SCS endpoint or patient-level validation. Hemibrain is incomplete and human KKI-18 has coarse structural resolution; the authors call for other-animal tests. Simulation code and network files were not executed here.

sources.название: A neural correlate of individual odor preference in Drosophila
sources.авторы: Matthew A. Churgin; Danylo O. Lavrentovich; Matthew A.-Y. Smith; Ruixuan Gao; Edward S. Boyden; Benjamin L. de Bivort
sources.издание: eLife 12:RP90511; Version of Record 11 March 2025 (reviewed preprint v1 17 October 2023)
sources.модальность: Adult Drosophila olfactory behavior and projection-neuron calcium responses; simulated spike dynamics in a hemibrain-derived antennal-lobe circuit.
sources.задача: Test whether microscale circuit variation can account for individual olfactory projection-neuron response patterns associated with odor preference.
sources.метод: Leaky-integrate-and-fire antennal-lobe simulation with 3062 model neurons and hemibrain release 1.2 connectivity; stochastic variation in input timing, cell populations and synapse density is compared with measured fly calcium-response variation.
sources.датасет: Hemibrain release 1.2 antennal-lobe graph, published odor-response inputs, in-vivo fly odor preference, projection-neuron calcium imaging and presynaptic Bruchpilot measurements. Figure/analysis code and partially processed data are deposited at Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14252278; full raw data by author hard-drive request.
sources.производительность: The paper reports that simulated synaptic variability recapitulates some patterns in measured projection-neuron calcium responses (Results > Developmental stochasticity; Fig. 4), while simulation variation is smaller than empirical variation; no cross-species or pain-endpoint predictive accuracy is reported.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: individual-fly physiological/behavioral observations are compared with simulated circuits, without a human holdout or fly-to-human transfer split
sources.ограничения: The simulation resamples components of one hemibrain antennal lobe to stand in for across-fly structural variation. Model outputs are compared to observed calcium patterns but do not establish a complete mechanistic explanation of individual odor preference. The experimental task is odor choice, not nociception, protective behavior, ECAP, clinical pain or SCS. The 7 GB Zenodo files and 600 GB request-only raw collection were not independently executed or inspected here.

sources.название: A neuromorphic model of olfactory processing and sparse coding in the Drosophila larva brain
sources.авторы: Anna-Maria Jürgensen; Afshin Khalili; Elisabetta Chicca; Giacomo Indiveri; Martin Paul Nawrot
sources.издание: Neuromorphic Computing and Engineering 1(2):024008; published 9 December 2021
sources.модальность: One first-instar larval olfactory-hemisphere wiring blueprint, software LIF simulation and DYNAP-SE neuromorphic-hardware emulation with artificial odor inputs.
sources.задача: Compare population and temporal sparse coding across feedback inhibition, lateral inhibition and spike-frequency adaptation configurations.
sources.метод: A 136-neuron olfactory-pathway spiking network uses population sizes and partial wiring from one EM-reconstructed larva; hypothesized APL feedback and cellular adaptation are added. Brian2 and DYNAP-SE implementations are compared under three artificial odors.
sources.датасет: Single reconstructed first-instar larval right-hemisphere olfactory pathway from prior EM work; three computer-generated odors, 20 repeated hardware trials per odor, and software model instances. No new larval neural-recording or pain cohort is evaluated.
sources.производительность: Figures 2-3 report modeled spike dynamics and population/temporal sparseness across circuit ablations, comparing chip and software; error bars summarize the three synthetic odors. These are model/hardware readouts, not in-vivo behavior or clinical accuracy.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: the circuit blueprint is from one larva and no held-out animal or patient-level prediction is evaluated
sources.ограничения: A partial larval olfactory circuit, not a whole-brain adult connectome or nociceptive pathway. Some synapses and adaptation mechanisms are hypothesized or hardware-constrained, not all directly reconstructed. Software/hardware comparison uses synthetic odor patterns; similarity to earlier in-vivo observations is contextual, not a new direct biological validation. Data are available on author request; code URL is stated but not executed in this review. No Drosophila pain, human ECAP/SCS, or cross-species transfer test.

sources.название: Neural signal propagation atlas of Caenorhabditis elegans
sources.авторы: Francesco Randi; Anuj K. Sharma; Sophie Dvali; Andrew M. Leifer
sources.модальность: Single-cell optogenetic stimulation, whole-brain calcium imaging, connectome-derived biophysical simulation and functional-kernel simulation.
sources.задача: Measure functional signal propagation across the C. elegans head and compare anatomical/connectome-derived versus functionally measured models when predicting spontaneous neural-activity correlations.
sources.метод: Optogenetic activation with whole-brain calcium imaging; anatomy-derived differential-equation model and kernel-based simulations; compare Pearson correlation between predicted and observed spontaneous-activity correlation structure.
sources.датасет: C. elegans signal-propagation measurements: 23,433 neuron pairs from 113 animals; connectome inputs include scaled average weights from three adult and one L4 connectome. Machine-readable measurements are available under OSF project E2SYT.
sources.производительность: Fig. 6 compares Pearson correlation with observed spontaneous-activity correlations: functional kernels predict them better than the anatomy-derived connectome model and bare anatomical weights. No numeric metric copied; no held-out-animal evaluation claimed.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: this is animal neurophysiology/model comparison, not human participant prediction; Fig. 6 is not a reported held-out-worm generalization test.
sources.ограничения: C. elegans neural dynamics only. The anatomy-derived model uses assumed synaptic signs, timescales and other biophysical parameters. Functional measurements are the paper's main result and outperform its anatomy-derived model in the Fig. 6 benchmark. No Drosophila nociception, subjective pain, human pain, ECAP, SCS, treatment-response or clinical endpoint.

sources.название: Range-Limited Scale Stability of Dynamic Direction Representations in a Connectome-Constrained Fly Visual Model
sources.авторы: Nalin Dhiman; Siddhrath Panwar
sources.модальность: Симулированные популяционные ответы замороженного FlyVis (connectome-constrained модель зрительной системы Drosophila) на рендер-стимулы: движущиеся полосы, трансляционные цели и геометрически scale-нейтральные движущиеся края. Биологической записи нет.
sources.задача: Leave-one-apparent-scale-out (LOSO) линейное декодирование направления движения во frozen FlyVis-чекпойнте; проверка устойчивости представления к исключённому видимому масштабу; острые вмешательства (T4/T5 state silencing, шаффлы параметров связности).
sources.метод: Замороженный, независимо предобученный (optical-flow) FlyVis-чекпойнт без дообучения; линейный декодер обучается на метках направления с остальных масштабов и тестируется на исключённом. Контроли: capacity- и sampling-matched временные модели (hex, collision-free square 32x32, self-only; 679 942 параметра; seeds 42/84/123). sources.название: A frozen rate operator from the complete larval connectome: degree and weight govern the gross response, exact wiring governs input routing and mushroom-body modes
sources.авторы: Stavros Therianos
sources.издание: arXiv preprint arXiv:2606.17745v2 [q-bio.NC], 21 pages, 6 figures, CC BY 4.0; v1 (submitted 16 Jun 2026) carried the different title 'Separating wiring-specific from statistical control of dynamics in a complete connectome'
sources.модальность: Larval Drosophila connectome run as a frozen leaky-tanh rate operator; simulated state covariance, eigenvalue and singular spectra, mode leverage; degree-and-weight double-edge-swap ensemble, cell-class block-preserving null, unstructured Gaussian control
sources.задача: Separate which dynamical properties of the complete larval connectome operator are fixed by degree and weight statistics and which require the exact placement of synapses, using level-matched null ensembles
sources.метод: 3,013-neuron larval connectome; 2,825-neuron strongly connected core; W[i,j] = reconstructed synapse count from j to i, rescaled to spectral radius rho* = 0.99; frozen leaky-tanh update x_n = (1-alpha) x_{n-1} + alpha tanh(W x_{n-1} + B s_n) with alpha = 0.9 and no fitted single-neuron parameter; metrics: non-normality sigma1/rho, participation-ratio effective rank, near-linearity, identity-resolved mode leverage, sparse afferent-port-drive active fraction; controls: 1,000-instance degree-and-weight rewiring ensemble (seeds 2000-2999), block-preserving 18-cell-class null, unstructured Gaussian operator, 1,000 random size-matched sets (seed 19019), singular-subspace guard, Westfall-Young family-wise max-statistic control over a 105-entry panel
sources.датасет: Winding et al. 2023 larval Drosophila connectome (Science 379:eadd9330): 3,013 neurons and 111,243 directed edges, edge weights equal reconstructed synapse counts and are used as magnitudes without sign. Strongly connected core 2,825 neurons and 109,438 internal edges with 536 self-loops; periphery 80 afferent ports (524 couplings), 97 efferent ports (1,161 couplings), 11 internal. Derived result files, integrity manifest, seeds and verification bundle at https://github.com/Stavros963/fcta; the connectome itself comes from the original public source.

sources.название: How sparse can a fly-brain model be? Connection strength, wiring placement, network state and task jointly determine function-preserving compression of the Drosophila connectome
sources.авторы: Donggyu An
sources.издание: bioRxiv preprint (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory), v2, 25 September 2026
sources.модальность: FlyWire connectome (v630; robustness repeat on v783) with simulated LIF spike activity and simulated behaviour readouts; no new biological recordings
sources.задача: Function-preserving sparsification of a validated whole-brain LIF model: which edges can be removed under a fixed budget while preserving validated feeding and grooming behaviour and population responses
sources.метод: Six edge-budget operators (weak-synapse magnitude pruning; uniform and weight-proportional random; degree-preserving rewiring; weight shuffling; task-aware |w|(1+r)); Brian2 LIF simulation of the Shiu et al. (2024) whole-brain model on FlyWire v630; three validated circuits; silent and spontaneously active states; 3-5 seeds and 3-10 trials
sources.датасет: FlyWire materialisation 630 as used by Shiu et al. (127,400 neurons; 14,687,178 weighted edges); robustness repeat on FlyWire v783 (138,639 neurons; 15.1M edges); no new experimental data
sources.производительность: Magnitude pruning holds the MN9 readout ratio at 0.79 with 6% of edges (k=10, population correlation 0.82), cliff k*~9.4; uniform random 0.02-0.12 at k=1 and 0 for k>=2; degree-preserving rewiring 0.00 at every k; weight shuffling 0.00 up to k=10; weight-proportional random collapses at k=5 (mean 0.34 vs 0.95); task-aware holds its training stimulus at 0.91-1.06 down to 0.4% of edges but bitter suppression falls to -0.06 at k=31; grooming specificity collapses below k=2; v783 plateau 0.70-0.71 with the same collapse between k=10 and 20
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: whole-brain connectome simulation with fly-derived readouts, no human participant prediction
sources.ограничения: One connectome version (v630) and one parameter set; the LIF model omits neuromodulation, electrical synapses, plasticity and morphology and assumes zero baseline firing; a +/-20% synaptic gain change moves the feeding cliff to k<5 or k~13; function is defined by only three gustatory and mechanosensory circuits (visual and navigational functions untested); the task-aware criterion is deliberately simple; the active state uses uniform white noise; the pre-registered 5 seeds and 5-10 trials were met only for key conditions; the water circuit was omitted. No nociception, ECAP, SCS or human transfer is tested.

sources.название: Neuromorphic Simulation of Drosophila Melanogaster Brain Connectome on Loihi 2
sources.авторы: Felix Wang; Bradley H. Theilman; Fred Rothganger; William Severa; Craig M. Vineyard; James B. Aimone
sources.модальность: connectome, simulation_state, neural_activity
sources.задача: Independent neuromorphic re-implementation and statistical validation of the Shiu et al. 2024 FlyWire whole-brain LIF model on Intel Loihi 2, plus a simple runtime scaling study over 0.5-40 Hz background spiking rates.
sources.метод: Reference Brian 2 two-state LIF model with refractory period (forward-Euler, 0.1 ms step, 1.8 ms synaptic delay, constant weights) replicated in STACS through SNN-dCSR partitioning; custom microcoded LIF and probabilistic-spiking neuron programs on Loihi 2; shared synaptic delivery and shared axon routing compression schemes; greedy partitioning against 128 KB per-neurocore synaptic memory; index-matched mean spike-rate parity against Brian 2 over ten independent trials.
sources.датасет: FlyWire adult Drosophila melanogaster whole-brain connectome (Parquet connection tables from the FlyWire database), simplified to a point-neuron model of ~140K neurons and ~15M synapses (reduced from ~50M by condensing identical synapses), with Poisson input neurons targeting sugar neurons. No study artifact or dataset is released by the authors.
sources.производительность: Parity plots over ten trials (Figs. 12-15): Loihi 2 spike rates largely track the Brian 2 reference, with systematic deviations attributed to conductance-only input delivery and 9-bit weight capping (454 negative and 637 positive weights capped, 0.007% of network weights). Table 1 wall-clock per 1 s simulated time: Brian 2 10.13-13.99 s; STACS 4.778-25.68 s; Loihi 2 (0.1 ms) 0.189-5.793 s; Loihi 2 (1 ms) 0.0958-4.800 s. Reported speedup ~3x to ~350x versus Brian 2, faster than real time at sparse activity. Fixed fan-in limit of 4096; 20 chips (2400 neurocores) for shared synaptic delivery versus 12 chips (1440 neurocores) for shared axon routing. No accuracy metric is reported.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: in-silico connectome simulation; no animal or human subject split
sources.ограничения: Single biological connectome, in-silico only. No nociception, noxious stimulus, ECAP, SCS, chronic-pain or human clinical construct is tested, and no animal-to-human or SCS transfer is implied. Validation is spike-rate parity against reference simulations (STACS, Brian 2), not against in-vivo neural activity. The authors offer no code or data release; the implementation relies on the low-level NxCore API. In the shared-synaptic-delivery variant some high fan-in neurons were structurally altered (fan-in artificially limited to 4096 with sampling and weight rescaling).

sources.название: Pre-registered spectral and certified mixing analysis of the male Drosophila central nervous system connectome
sources.авторы: Eran Kopel
sources.издание: arXiv preprint arXiv:2609.33054v1 [q-bio.NC]; submitted 27 Sep 2026; 14 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables; CC BY 4.0
sources.модальность: Structural connectome graph analysed as a synapse-flow Markov chain (connectome and simulation_state only); no neural recording, no spiking dynamics and no behavioural or clinical measurement
sources.задача: Pre-registered single-run test of five hypotheses about the synapse-flow random walk on the male Drosophila central nervous system connectome: H1 the spectral gap and its dependence on the neck connective; H2 the localisation of the leading modes of an input-normalised signed map; H3 the certified mixing depth measured by the Dobrushin coefficient at a five-synapse threshold; H4 its robustness to per-synapse detection confidence; H5 the dependence of the signed spectrum on the neurotransmitter sign convention.
sources.метод: Male CNS connectome v1.0 flat release at minimum synapse confidence 0.5 (CC-BY): 166,700 annotated neurons, 25,582,938 directed edges carrying 124,177,617 synapses after restriction to neuron pairs; giant strongly connected component 165,314 neurons at w>=1 and 157,821 at w>=5. Row-stochastic synapse-flow chain P_ij = w_ij / sum_k w_ik, stationary distribution by power iteration, leading eigenvalues by ARPACK (tolerance 1e-8). Dobrushin coefficient tau(P^r) bounded from below by witness rows and from above by hub columns, with an a priori rounding bound of about r(D+1)u so that the bounds hold for the exact chain. Perturbation classes: uniform multiplicative class C(delta) and a confidence class that allows any subset of synapses below level c to be false detections (Lemma 1 and Lemma 2). The pre-registration was frozen on 19 Sep 2026, made public byte-identical on 26 Sep 2026, and each hypothesis was run once. Exploratory (not pre-registered) analyses add smallest-conductance sweep cuts, exact confidence-derived chains M(c) and B(k), cell-type-preserving null models N1-N3 and a FlyWire female-brain comparison.
sources.датасет: Male CNS connectome version 1.0, flat-connectome release at minimum synapse confidence 0.5 (FlyEM and collaborators, CC-BY; https://male-cns.janelia.org/download/). Reused, not minted: no dataset DOI is issued for this release. Comparison-only inputs: FlyWire female whole-brain connectome (version 783, 139,255 proofread neurons, 54.5 million synapses), its annotations, and a signed-map sign convention from Pospisil et al. 2024. Code, pre-registration, logs and result files: github.com/erankopel/maleCNS-depth, with the registration record at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22980248 and the frozen confirmatory analysis at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22981189.
sources.производительность: Pre-registered outcomes (Table 1). H1: |lambda_2| = 0.94503 at w>=1 and 0.996524 at w>=5 (predicted interval [0.90, 0.97], so the gap at five synapses is an order of magnitude smaller than predicted); knock-outs give 1-|lambda_2| = 0.000190 without ascending, descending and sensory-ascending neurons and a 0.000726 move without motor neurons. H2: with the input floor F = 342 (median) the signed spectral radius is 0.83484 (< 0.85) and 19 of the top 20 modes have participation ratio > 20; unfloored leading pairs are -0.9151, +0.9137, -0.9122, +0.9098 carried by two R7/R8 photoreceptors each. H3: certified lower bound on tau(P^32) at w>=5 is 0.9229 (> 0.20) but no checkpoint below 0.05 occurs up to 128 steps (0.6695 at 128). H4: no certificate at any level tested (best 0.071 at c = 0.51; -0.52 at the pre-registered c = 0.70). H5: rho changes by 0.000015 under the Pospisil convention and the same six neurons carry the top modes. Exploratory (Table 3): the slow mode at w>=5 is an 11-neuron set holding 12.8% of stationary mass with escape probability 3.5e-3; removing it gives |lambda_2| = 0.9806. FlyWire brain at w>=1 has |lambda_2| = 0.99999 set by seven lamina neurons holding ~1e-4 of stationary mass. Confidence-derived chains move witness distances at r = 32 by at most 0.017 at the pre-registered level.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: one reconstructed structural connectome analysed as a Markov chain, with no participants, no live animals and no held-out cohort; the only variability reported is across synthetic null rewirings, confidence-derived chains and a second (female, FlyWire) reconstruction used for comparison
sources.ограничения: The confidence class models false detections only; missing synapses, common under incomplete proofreading, are outside it, so a class allowing them would be larger. Only the tau(P^r) bounds are certified; eigenvalues are ARPACK estimates at tolerance 1e-8 and are not. The chains are not reversible, so sweep cuts locate metastable sets only heuristically. The FlyWire comparison differs in sex, reconstruction pipeline and synapse detection. Most of all the synapse-flow chain is a structural object: it describes how a walker following synapses spreads over the wiring diagram, not how activity spreads in a fly. The paper contains no nociception, noxious stimulus, ECAP, SCS, chronic-pain or human clinical construct, and states no animal-to-human or SCS transfer.

метод.value: Male CNS connectome v1.0 flat release at minimum synapse confidence 0.5 (CC-BY): 166,700 annotated neurons, 25,582,938 directed edges carrying 124,177,617 synapses after restriction to neuron pairs; giant strongly connected component 165,314 neurons at w>=1 and 157,821 at w>=5. Row-stochastic synapse-flow chain P_ij = w_ij / sum_k w_ik, stationary distribution by power iteration, leading eigenvalues by ARPACK (tolerance 1e-8). производительность.value: Pre-registered outcomes (Table 1). H1: |lambda_2| = 0.94503 at w>=1 and 0.996524 at w>=5 (predicted interval [0.90, 0.97], so the gap at five synapses is an order of magnitude smaller than predicted); knock-outs give 1-|lambda_2| = 0.000190 without ascending, descending and sensory-ascending neurons and a 0.000726 move without motor neurons. H2: with the input floor F = 342 (median) the signed spectral radius is 0.83484 (< 0.85) and 19 of the top 20 modes have participation ratio > 20; unfloored leading pairs are -0.9151, +0.9137, -0.9122, +0.9098 carried by two R7/R8 photoreceptors each. H3: certified lower bound on tau(P^32) at w>=5 is 0.9229 (> 0.20) but no checkpoint below 0.05 occurs up to 128 steps (0.6695 at 128). H4: no certificate at any level tested (best 0.071 at c = 0.51; -0.52 at the pre-registered c = 0.70). H5: rho changes by 0.000015 under the Pospisil convention and the same six neurons carry the top modes. Exploratory (Table 3): the slow mode at w>=5 is an 11-neuron set holding 12.8% of stationary mass with escape probability 3.5e-3; removing it gives |lambda_2| = 0.9806. FlyWire brain at w>=1 has |lambda_2| = 0.99999 set by seven lamina neurons holding ~1e-4 of stationary mass. Confidence-derived chains move witness distances at r = 32 by at most 0.017 at the pre-registered level.

ограничения.value: The confidence class models false detections only; missing synapses, common under incomplete proofreading, are outside it, so a class allowing them would be larger. Only the tau(P^r) bounds are certified; eigenvalues are ARPACK estimates at tolerance 1e-8 and are not. The chains are not reversible, so sweep cuts locate metastable sets only heuristically. The FlyWire comparison differs in sex, reconstruction pipeline and synapse detection. Most of all the synapse-flow chain is a structural object: it describes how a walker following synapses spreads over the wiring diagram, not how activity spreads in a fly. The paper contains no nociception, noxious stimulus, ECAP, SCS, chronic-pain or human clinical construct, and states no animal-to-human or SCS transfer.

sources.название: Connectome-based biophysical modeling of a figure-ground discrimination circuit
sources.авторы: Ziyin Liu; Yifei Lu; Alexander Borst; Sven Dorkenwald; Tomaso Poggio
sources.издание: bioRxiv preprint (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory / openRxiv), v1 posted 24 September 2026
sources.модальность: Connectome-constrained, morphologically detailed biophysical simulation (FlyWire FAFB materialisation v783) with synthetic compound-eye visual stimuli and simulated membrane potentials; no new biological recordings
sources.задача: Identify and test in silico the biological implementation of the Reichardt-Poggio-Hausen (RPH) figure-ground discrimination circuit, and predict the role of the vCH wide-field pool cell in gating T4a elementary motion detector axon terminals.
sources.метод: Biophysically accurate multi-compartment models built from connectomic morphology: a T4a model driven by five medulla input classes (Mi1, Tm3, Mi9, Mi4, C3) over three spatial subfields, coupled to a 2,481-compartment vCH model through connectome-identified bidirectional contacts; motion-opponency (T4b-LPi15) and binocular (H2) pathways added; passive-cable spectral analysis of vCH versus CT1 (eigen-compartments, slow-mode counts, relocation maps); exhaustive ablation of all 2^14 = 16,384 subsets of 14 circuit pathways at three figure-ground phases; independent replication by rebuilding the binocular circuit from the male CNS connectome (MCNS). Fine modeling details are in Appendices A-N.
sources.датасет: FlyWire FAFB adult Drosophila brain connectome, materialisation v783, with official FlyWire version 3 synapse data; male CNS connectome (MCNS) used as an independent reconstruction for replication; T4 direction/polarity/speed reference data from the Borst 2022 dataset. No new experimental data.
sources.производительность: Intact binocular circuit gives RSI_180 = 0.41 and RSI_90 = 0.30 across 77 figure-covering T4a cells; the minimal reciprocal pair T4a->vCH plus vCH->T4a alone gives RSI_180 = 0.11, and a six-pathway circuit reaches RSI_180 = 0.41 (99% of intact). Single ablations: only vCH->T4a is indispensable (selectivity vanishes at both phases); five further pathways each cost >0.10 of RSI_180 (T4a->vCH, H2->vCH, T4b->H2, LPi15->vCH, T4b->LPi15) and the remaining eight change it by <0.009. Axonal peak potentials vary by 10.2 mV across the phase sweep versus 4.0 mV (dendrite) and 4.9 mV (soma); vCH ablation reduces contralateral-ground variation to <=0.05 mV and changes the binocular axonal tuning depth from 8.4 to 0.2 mV, whereas LPi15 ablation leaves it at 5.1 mV. vCH versus CT1 passive spectra: 30,238 versus 165,598 compartments, CT1 roughly sevenfold slower beyond about mode ten, and 75 versus 10 modes slower than 1 ms. MCNS replication: RSI_180 = 0.32 +/- 0.02 (against 0.31 +/- 0.02 in FlyWire), per-phase RSI correlation r = 0.98, vCH membrane-potential correlation r = 0.99.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: in-silico connectome biophysical model; no animal or human participant split
sources.ограничения: In-silico only: no new electrophysiology or behaviour, and the stated predictions (T4a dendrite-versus-axon potential split, opposite-sign action of vCH and LPi15, LC15 relative-motion selectivity, H2 silencing effects, plus 16,000 ablation predictions) are testable hypotheses, not verified measurements. The simulation omits lobula small-object neurons and their LLPC/LPLC interactions, models the compound eye as non-interacting simple ODEs without Mi4/Mi9 feedback, omits the T5 pathways and the T4a->T4b motion-opponency path (e.g. LPi14), and rests on a single connectome version and one parameter set. Gap junctions between vCH and HS cells are invisible in the connectome and are argued rather than measured. No nociception, pain, ECAP, SCS or human transfer is measured or claimed.

sources.название: Identification and function of thermosensory neurons in Drosophila larvae
sources.авторы: Lei Liu; Olena Yermolaieva; Wayne A. Johnson; Francois M. Abboud; Michael J. Welsh
sources.издание: Nature Neuroscience 6(3):267-273; published online 2003-02-03, print issue 2003-03
sources.модальность: Larval yellow cameleon 2.1 calcium imaging; extracellular electrophysiology of terminal organ neurons; temperature-gradient behavioral preference assays
sources.задача: Primary experimental mapping of thermoresponsive neurons in Drosophila melanogaster larvae and of their physiological responses to cooling and heating. Whether the tested thermal range is noxious and whether the measured response is nociceptive is not established in the accessible primary text.
sources.метод: Yellow cameleon 2.1 calcium imaging of terminal sensory organ, dorsal organ and body-wall (dorsal/lateral) neurons; extracellular electrophysiological recordings from terminal organ neurons during controlled cooling and heating (abstract reports increased activity on cooling by <=1 degree C and distinct unit response patterns); behavioral temperature-preference tests in larvae with disrupted terminal organ function. Verification rests on the publisher abstract, the figure 1-6 captions and bibliographic metadata: the Methods body is paywalled, so stimulus calibration, preparation details, cell/animal counts and analysis parameters were not read.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: the article reports experimental imaging, electrophysiology and behavioral preference assays with no predictive model, train/test split or held-out-animal evaluation.
sources.ограничения: Access limits: Nature full text and PDF are paywalled (plain curl HTTP 303 to the identity redirect; the landing page needed a desktop browser User-Agent and still exposes only abstract, figure captions, references and affiliations). Europe PMC reports isOpenAccess=N, inEPMC=N, inPMC=N, hasPDF=N and "Subscription required"; Unpaywall "closed" with no OA location; OpenAlex no OA location; no arXiv version exists. Construct limits: cooling/heating here is thermosensory stimulation and the accessible text establishes neither a noxious dose nor a nociceptive response nor subjective pain; adjacent nociception studies must not supply the missing dose or construct. Transfer limits: no ECAP, SCS, clinical outcome or human data, and no Drosophila-to-human transfer is tested or supported.

provenance.import_source: SRC-04 follow-up of the unreconciled lead 10.1038/nn1009 recorded in data/audits/drosophila/drosophila-nociception-audit.json; identity and abstract rechecked through the publisher page, Europe PMC and Crossref
provenance.query_or_seed: doi 10.1038/nn1009; Drosophila nociception related lead (seed S778 reference BIB18)

evidence.population: Drosophila melanogaster larvae: terminal sensory organ neurons, dorsal organ neurons and dorsal/lateral body-wall neurons in larval preparations, plus separate behavioral cohorts of larvae with disrupted terminal organ function. Analytic animal and neuron counts are in the paywalled Methods and figure legends and were not read.
evidence.sample_size: unavailable_after_search: counts exist only in the paywalled Methods and figure legends; Europe PMC shows no PMC copy (inPMC=N, hasPDF=N), Unpaywall is closed and the publisher PDF route returned HTTP 303, so no N could be read.
evidence.target_label: Direction and pattern of change in the cameleon calcium signal and in extracellular firing of larval thermosensitive neurons during cooling/heating (terminal organ neurons increased activity on cooling by <=1 degree C and reduced basal activity on heating; dorsal organ neurons unaffected; body-wall neurons showed diverse thermal responses), plus cold/warm temperature preference in larvae with disrupted terminal organ function. This is a thermosensory, not a nociceptive or pain, label.
