sources.название: The Drosophila Connectome as a Computational Reservoir for Time-Series Prediction
sources.авторы: Leone Costi; Alexander Hadjiivanov; Dominik Dold; Zachary F. Hale; Dario Izzo
sources.издание: Biomimetics (MDPI), volume 10, issue 5, article 341; published online 21 May 2025; DOI 10.3390/biomimetics10050341; PMID 40422171; PMC12109256; open access under CC BY 4.0. Peer-reviewed journal article, not a preprint.
sources.модальность: Complete adult Drosophila whole-brain connectome (FlyWire, extracted with the CAVE client caveclient 6.4.1) converted into an echo-state-network connectivity matrix, with simulated reservoir states and predicted circular-restricted three-body-problem (CR3BP) chaotic time series. Structural connectome plus simulation state only: no live-fly recording, no electrophysiology, no behaviour and no human data.
sources.задача: Test whether the topology and the synaptic-weight distribution of the complete fruit-fly connectome, used as the recurrent matrix of an echo state network, give a reservoir-computing advantage in multivariate chaotic time-series prediction, in particular higher resilience to overfitting than standard randomly initialised reservoirs, and whether topology and weights act independently.
sources.метод: Echo state network x_n = (1-a)x_(n-1) + a tanh(W x_(n-1) + W_in[1;u_n]) with leakage a = 0.9, fixed input scaling 0.7 and a ridge-regression readout W_out = Y X^T (X X^T + b I)^-1. W is built from the connectome: magnitude from the CAVE connection (synapse-size) score, sign positive for acetylcholine/glutamate and negative for GABA; octopamine, serotonin and dopamine synapses are excluded because the firing-rate model has no resting potential. Each matrix is rescaled to spectral radius 0.99. Two extraction criteria (most connected; proportional to the class distribution of the whole connectome) with the largest-connected-component and nearest-neighbour repair steps, for reservoir sizes N up to 1500. Four architectures are compared under identical size, sparsity, spectral radius, input matrix and input scaling: control (random topology, uniform or Gaussian weights); connectome topology with connectome weights; connectome topology with random weights; random topology with connectome weights; plus a fifth variant with connectome topology and shuffled connectome weights. Monte Carlo over N, criterion, weight distribution, beta and forecast horizon. Statistics: Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon test and Bhattacharyya distance between nRMSE distributions. Separate whole-connectome experiment restricts input-receiving and readout-connected neurons to the input and output neuron classes of Table 2. Separate spectral-radius sweep at 0.99, 0.75, 0.5 and 0.25.
sources.датасет: FlyWire complete adult Drosophila brain connectome accessed through the CAVE client caveclient 6.4.1, with cell classes following Schlegel et al. 2024 (ref. 46). After synapse quality filtering (post-synaptic neuron inside the classified set; cleft score >= 50 and connection score >= 100) the graph has 104,909 neurons and forms a single connected graph. No dataset DOI is stated. The prediction task uses synthetic rather than animal data: 5 CR3BP trajectories from a 1% variation of the initial conditions, 10,000 datapoints each, propagated with heyoka 6.1.2 at the Earth-Moon mass ratio and timestep 0.1, split into washout, training and test subsets. Code and results: https://gitlab.com/EuropeanSpaceAgency/fly_connectome (accessed 20 May 2025).
sources.производительность: Metric: normalized RMSE (nRMSE) on the training and test sets, plus the train-test gap as an overfitting measure. Per hyperparameter combination: 5 trajectories x 10 random re-initialisations = 50 test cases. The fully biomimetic reservoir (connectome topology + connectome weights) was significantly less prone to overfitting than the standard control and stayed stable as N grew, most clearly at weak regularisation beta = 1e-6, while at strong regularisation beta = 1e-3 it had almost consistently the highest error. The two hybrid designs fell between the fully biomimetic and the control architecture, with the weight distribution contributing more than the topology at large N. Shuffling the connectome weights was statistically equivalent to randomising the topology (Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon p > 0.05 for all tested N and beta), with averaged Bhattacharyya distances 3.2e-3 +/- 2e-3 (most connected) and 1.6e-3 +/- 1e-3 (proportional), which the authors read as a tight topology-weight mapping. Whole-connectome experiment: nRMSE < 2% at beta = 1e-6, with similar training and test errors despite about 22x10^3 trainable readout parameters; at beta = 1e-3 the control architecture outperformed the connectome-based one on both sets. Spectral radius 0.99 performed better than 0.75, 0.5 and 0.25 in both models. Selection criterion (most connected vs proportional) did not change the ranking of architectures.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: a single reconstructed connectome is analysed in silico, with no animals, no human participants and no held-out cohort. The only variability reported is across synthetic CR3BP trajectories and random reservoir re-initialisations (5 trajectories x 10 repeats = 50 cases per condition).
sources.ограничения: In-silico, single-connectome study. The source says only that the data are the FlyWire complete connectome of a fruit fly brain (ref. 46 = Schlegel et al. 2024) and that it was read through caveclient 6.4.1; it states no FlyWire materialisation/version (e.g. v783), no sex (FlyWire is one adult female) and no reconstruction release identifier, so the exact connectome version is not established in the checked text. Biological realism is reduced to a matrix: connection score is used as a proxy for synaptic strength (anatomy only, no physiological measurement), signs come from inferred per-synapse neurotransmitter probabilities, modulatory transmitters are dropped, and the network fits no membrane or synaptic time constant. The exploratory reservoirs (N up to 1500) are small subgraphs extracted from the graph, and the whole-connectome run keeps only class-restricted input and readout connectivity and uses single-timestep prediction with 3 repeats per trajectory instead of 10. There is no experimental comparator of any kind: every comparison is against randomised or hybrid in-silico reservoirs, with no live-fly recording, no behavioural readout, no human participant, no cross-subject or cross-species transfer, and no external validation. Explicit boundary: the checked full text contains no nociception or nociceptive-response construct, no noxious stimulus, no pain label, no ECAP, no SCS and no clinical or animal-to-human transfer, so it licenses no pain-related inference. Figures and equations were read as text/tables, not re-executed; the code repository was not run.

sources.название: Biological Processing Units: Leveraging an Insect Connectome to Pioneer Biofidelic Neural Architectures
sources.авторы: Siyu Yu; Zihan Qin; Tingshan Liu; Beiya Xu; R. Jacob Vogelstein; Jason Brown; Joshua T. Vogelstein
sources.издание: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI 2025); Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNAI, vol. 16058), Springer, Cham, pp. 361-369; First Online 7 August 2025; print and copyright 2026; accepted author manuscript arXiv:2507.10951v1 [cs.NE]
sources.модальность: Fixed recurrent network whose weights are the signed larval Drosophila connectome (electron-microscopy synapse counts with neurotransmitter-derived polarity): ~3,000 neurons and ~65,000 weights between them, partitioned into 430 sensory, 218 output and 2,304 internal neurons; simulated unrolled activity; inputs are MNIST/CIFAR-10 images and ChessBench chess positions encoded by GNN/CNN front ends. No biological recording and no live animal in the study.
sources.задача: Test whether a complete insect connectome can be used unmodified as a fixed recurrent computational core (Biological Processing Unit, BPU) for image classification and chess puzzle solving, how far performance scales with a statistically generated expansion of the connectome, and which sensory subsystems carry the performance.
sources.метод: Axon-to-dendrite adjacency matrix of the larval brain connectome with each connection's sign imposed from neurotransmitter annotations; the recurrent weight matrices (sensory/internal/output blocks of Eq. 1) are frozen and only the input and output projections are trained by gradient descent over a fixed number of unrolled steps with ReLU activations. Expansion to N = F*N0 (F = 1..5) uses a directed signed degree-corrected stochastic block model that bootstraps in/out degrees within blocks, draws Poisson edge counts and Bernoulli polarity, and restores the original block exactly. Images are flattened and linearly projected into the sensory subspace; the baseline is a two-hidden-layer MLP whose trainable projections match the BPU projection parameter count while its hidden-to-hidden transform stays a fixed random projection. Chess inputs use either a 65-node GNN encoder (12-dim piece one-hot per square, 22 global hub features, 7-bit edge attributes, 128-dim projections, two GINEConv layers, mean+max pooling to 256 dims) or a CNN encoder (FEN tokenized to [24,8,8] = 22 semantic plus 2 coordinate channels, six-layer residual conv with squeeze-and-excitation and stochastic depth, global average pooling to 256 dims); three variants are evaluated (GNN, CNN, CNN with depth-6 minimax and alpha-beta pruning at inference).
sources.датасет: Larval Drosophila connectome of Winding et al. 2023 (Science 379:eadd9330); the paper says the adjacency comes from electron-microscopy reconstructions and cites refs [1] (Winding larval connectome) and [4] (Lappalainen et al. 2024, adult visual system) inconsistently. Reported counts: ~3,000 neurons and ~65,000 weights, of which 430 sensory, 218 output (DN-SEZ and ring-gland neurons) and 2,304 internal neurons. Benchmarks: MNIST (784-dim) and CIFAR-10 (3,072-dim) linearly mapped into the sensory subspace; ChessBench (10^7 Lichess board positions in FEN annotated by Stockfish 16, training budgets 10^4/10^5/10^6 games) and final evaluation on 10,000 curated Lichess puzzles (Elo 399-2867 with full solution sequences). No new experimental dataset, no deposited dataset identifier, no connectome version or materialization number stated in the checked text.
sources.производительность: Image classification: the full-connectome BPU reaches 98% MNIST and 58% CIFAR-10 against 97% and 52% for the projection-parameter-matched two-layer MLP; CIFAR-10 accuracy rises monotonically with DCSBM expansion factor F and stays above the size-matched MLP (Fig. 2). Modality-restricted reservoirs are non-monotonic in neuron count (the 26-neuron respiratory group outperforms the 29-neuron sight group at small training sizes). Chess: the GNN-BPU with 232,912 trainable parameters reaches 59%, 61% and 63% puzzle accuracy at 10^4, 10^5 and 10^6 training games, while the abstract states 60% at 10,000 games and "nearly 10x better than any size transformer"; the CNN-BPU at ~2M parameters exceeds a reimplemented 2M Transformer, and with depth-6 minimax plus alpha-beta pruning reaches 91.71% puzzle accuracy against a 9M-parameter Transformer baseline. No seed spread, confidence interval or significance test is reported for these numbers; the Fig. 2B bands are described only as average over five runs.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: one connectome is used as a fixed weight matrix and all tasks are synthetic benchmarks (MNIST, CIFAR-10, ChessBench puzzles); no participant, animal or held-out-subject prediction is defined.
sources.ограничения: Explicit boundary: the paper contains no nociception, no noxious stimulus, no protective behaviour, no pain label, no ECAP, no SCS and no human data or clinical transfer, so it licenses no insect-to-human pain inference. The connectome is the larval Drosophila reconstruction of Winding et al. 2023 (~3,000 neurons, ~65,000 weights), a single reconstruction with no version or materialization number stated in the checked text, and it is injected as a signed, non-spiking weight matrix: action potentials, single-neuron time constants, graded and short-term synaptic dynamics, neuromodulation and gap junctions are omitted, and polarity is assigned from neurotransmitter annotations. The recurrent core is frozen, but the input/output projections and the GNN/CNN front ends are trained, so the headline accuracies measure a reservoir plus trained encoders, not the connectome alone. There is no experimental comparator: no live-animal or human recording, no fly behavioural benchmark, and the reference points are size-matched MLP and Transformer baselines (the 2M Transformer reimplemented by the authors, the 9M checkpoint evaluated pretrained), which bounds any biological claim. One training run per condition is reported, with no seeds, confidence intervals or statistical tests; only the Fig. 2B expansion curves carry a five-run band. The abstract claim of "60% move accuracy ... nearly 10x better than any size transformer" at 10,000 games does not match the body text (59% at 10^4 games, surpassing only the smallest reference model) and the comparison factor is not derivable from the checked text. The connectome citation is internally inconsistent (ref [1] larval connectome versus ref [4] adult visual-system study cited for the adjacency). The modality-ablation reading is offered as correlation, and the authors note the 6-hour-old larva may have immature circuits. The publisher version of record is paywalled; the checked full text is the CC BY 4.0 accepted author manuscript arXiv:2507.10951v1, and no code or data availability statement was found in it.

There is no experimental comparator: no live-animal or human recording, no fly behavioural benchmark, and the reference points are size-matched MLP and Transformer baselines (the 2M Transformer reimplemented by the authors, the 9M checkpoint evaluated pretrained), which bounds any biological claim. One training run per condition is reported, with no seeds, confidence intervals or statistical tests; only the Fig. 2B expansion curves carry a five-run band. The abstract claim of "60% move accuracy ... nearly 10x better than any size transformer" at 10,000 games does not match the body text (59% at 10^4 games, surpassing only the smallest reference model) and the comparison factor is not derivable from the checked text. The connectome citation is internally inconsistent (ref [1] larval connectome versus ref [4] adult visual-system study cited for the adjacency). The modality-ablation reading is offered as correlation, and the authors note the 6-hour-old larva may have immature circuits. The publisher version of record is paywalled; the checked full text is the CC BY 4.0 accepted author manuscript arXiv:2507.10951v1, and no code or data availability statement was found in it.

sources.название: Connectome-based reservoir computing with the conn2res toolbox
sources.авторы: Laura E. Suárez; Agoston Mihalik; Filip Milisav; Kenji Marshall; Mingze Li; Petra E. Vértes; Guillaume Lajoie; Bratislav Misic
sources.издание: Nature Communications 15, article 656 (2024); Article, published online 22 January 2024; DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-44900-4; PMID 38253577; PMCID PMC10803782; CC BY 4.0
sources.модальность: Connectomes imposed as reservoir recurrent matrices: a group-level human structural (diffusion-MRI) connectome (Griffa et al. 2019), a single subject-level human connectome stratified by intrinsic networks, and tract-tracing connectomes of fruit fly, mouse, rat and macaque; NeuroGym/conn2res task datasets; simulated reservoir states under tanh, sigmoid, ReLU and leaky-ReLU units or a leaky-integrate-and-fire spiking model with a double-exponential synaptic filter, plus a dedicated memristive physical-reservoir class; spectral-radius sweep and 500 rewired null connectomes
sources.задача: Present conn2res, an open-source Python toolbox that implements biological neural networks as reservoirs, and demonstrate how connectome architecture, local unit dynamics and the global dynamical regime (spectral radius alpha) shape performance on cognitive tasks (perceptual decision making, context-dependent decision making, memory capacity)
sources.метод: Reservoir computing (echo-state network / liquid state machine) wrapped around a biological connectome: the connectivity matrix is the fixed reservoir network architecture (binary or weighted, directed or undirected), user-defined input and readout node sets, local dynamics from artificial neurons (linear, ReLU, leaky ReLU, sigmoid, tanh) or a leaky-integrate-and-fire spiking model with double-exponential synaptic filtering and optional heterogeneous synaptic time constants, interneuron-specific connectivity constraints and artificial stimulation or inhibition; global dynamics tuned by rescaling to a target spectral radius alpha; only the readout is trained (a Scikit-Learn linear model on readout-node time series). Six modules (tasks.py, connectivity.py with the Conn class, reservoir.py, readout.py, performance.py, plotting.py). Evaluation includes rewired null connectomes preserving density and degree sequence (Maslov-Sneppen), balanced accuracy and F1 for classification, memory capacity and prediction metrics for regression, and performance curves as a function of alpha
sources.датасет: Human diffusion-MRI structural connectome of the Griffa et al. 2019 Zenodo release (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.2872624; the paper states n = 66 participants analysed, while that deposit is titled "70 young healthy adults"); one subject-level human connectome with cortical nodes grouped into the Yeo intrinsic networks; fruit fly (Chiang et al. 2011, flycircuit.tw), mouse (Allen connectivity.brain-map.org), rat (Bota et al. 2015, brancusi1.usc.edu) and macaque (Modha & Singh 2010) connectomes; more than 20 NeuroGym behavioural tasks; 500 rewired null connectomes per comparison. No new dataset is released; the dataset identifier recorded here is the human connectome deposit that the paper points to
sources.производительность: Human group-level connectome memory capacity at criticality (alpha = 1) is significantly greater than in 500 density- and degree-sequence-preserving rewired nulls (p = 0.002). In the single-subject perceptual decision-making reservoir, readout modules differ strongly across intrinsic networks (one-way ANOVA F = 1143.50, p < 0.002 at alpha = 1), with default-mode and somatomotor networks performing best. Cross-species memory capacity at peak: mouse p < 0.002 at alpha_peak = 1.05, rat p < 0.002 at alpha_peak = 1.15, macaque p < 0.002 at alpha_peak = 1.15, but fruit fly only p = 0.11 at alpha_peak = 0.9. In the toolbox-component example, both tasks benefit from tanh over sigmoid, and the dependence on alpha is task-specific; these tutorial curves are shown only in figures and are not extracted as numbers here
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: the reservoir analyses use one group-level consensus connectome (n = 66 diffusion-MRI participants) and one subject-level connectome as fixed network architectures, with no participant-disjoint train/test protocol reported; the reported variability is across task iterations, alpha values and null rewirings, not across held-out subjects
sources.ограничения: Toolbox and demonstration paper, not a clinical or biological measurement study: every reservoir result is in silico. The human results come from connectomes of 66 healthy adults and one subject; there is no participant-disjoint split, no held-out external cohort and no predictive cross-subject validation of any structure-function claim. The paper states n = 66 for the Zenodo deposit titled "70 young healthy adults", so the exact analysis subset is not resolved here. Human connectomes come from diffusion MRI with the resolution and tractography limitations of that modality, and the cross-species comparison mixes connectomes of very different scale, resolution and reconstruction technique, uses sensory areas as input and motor areas as readout by convention, and reports no significant advantage for the fruit fly. Only the linear readout is trained; the reservoir is a simplified dynamical system (static weights, no plasticity, no delays) that omits receptor kinetics, neuromodulation and behavioural state, so the work licenses no claim about activity of the living brain. The spiking and memristive options are exposed by the toolbox but the demonstrated quantitative results are for rate units. Explicit boundary: the paper contains no nociception or nociceptive-response construct, no noxious stimulus, no pain label, no protective behaviour, no ECAP, no SCS and no clinical outcome; its Drosophila connectome is the 2011 Chiang et al. single-cell-resolution brain-wide wiring reconstruction (adult fly data set), not a larval connectome and not the FlyWire or hemibrain release, and it is used only as one of four network architectures in a comparative memory-capacity simulation, with no experimental comparator, no animal experiment and no fly-to-human or human-to-human transfer tested.

ограничения.value: Toolbox and demonstration paper, not a clinical or biological measurement study: every reservoir result is in silico. The human results come from connectomes of 66 healthy adults and one subject; there is no participant-disjoint split, no held-out external cohort and no predictive cross-subject validation of any structure-function claim. sources.название: Integrative neuromechanics of crawling in D. melanogaster larvae
sources.авторы: Cengiz Pehlevan; Paolo Paoletti; L Mahadevan
sources.издание: eLife 5:e11031, published online 25 July 2016, version of record v1
sources.модальность: Minimal neuromechanical model of the larval body, ventral nerve cord and substrate: coupled Wilson-Cowan excitation-inhibition populations per segment, linear spring-damper body segments, threshold friction, muscle forces and simulated proprioceptive feedback. No new animal recording; no connectome used.
sources.задача: Build and test a minimal integrative mathematical model that couples segmental excitation-inhibition neural dynamics to muscular force production and body-substrate friction in order to explain forward rectilinear crawling of Drosophila larvae with and without proprioception.
sources.метод: Ten-segment model: Wilson-Cowan excitatory/inhibitory populations per VNC segment (Eq. 1) with posterior-to-anterior neural coupling and proprioceptive coupling from stretch receptors (Eq. 2); body modelled as a chain of masses joined by damped linear springs with head-tail coupling (Eq. 3-4); friction vanishes above a muscular-force threshold (Eq. 5). Dimensionless parameters (Table 1) were tuned to published first- and third-instar crawling metrics; equations were integrated numerically with a small inertial term using explicit MATLAB schemes (Appendix 2). Model behaviour is compared with published experiments (Heckscher et al. 2012; Hughes and Thomas 2007; Inada et al. 2011; Kohsaka et al. 2014) and used to predict effects of changing body-substrate friction and neural coupling.
sources.датасет: No new dataset; an in-silico ten-segment simulation. Empirical comparators are literature values only: third-instar larvae ~4 mm / ~1.5 waves/s and ~1 mm/s and ~30% peak segmental contraction (Hughes and Thomas, 2007), first-instar ~600 um and 0.5-1.5 waves/s and ~40-125 um/s and ~3 segments off the ground (Heckscher et al., 2012), plus optogenetic VNC perturbations (Inada et al., 2011; Kohsaka et al., 2014). Neither an EM connectome nor a single experimental cohort is used; comparison is to numbers quoted from other papers, not to reanalysed raw recordings.
sources.производительность: Model reproduces the qualitative crawling gait and matches the cited literature metrics within the stated comparisons: ~0.04 waves per tau_E implying tau_E ~ 25 ms and a predicted speed ~0.5 mm/s versus observed ~1 mm/s in third instar, and ~30-90 um/s versus ~40-125 um/s in first instar; ~30% peak segmental contraction and typically ~3 segments lifted, both consistent with the cited experiments. It reproduces arrest and resumption after modelled optogenetic shutdown of one segment. No accuracy metric against a held-out cohort, no human outcome, no ECAP or SCS endpoint; several comparisons are order-of-magnitude rather than quantitative fits.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: a single in-silico model compared with pooled literature values; no held-out animal or human participant prediction task
sources.ограничения: A minimal theoretical model, not new measurements. It is two-dimensional rectilinear forward crawling of a generic ten-segment larva; no connectome, no identified cell types and no spiking neurons are used, so no connectome version applies. The VNC is a two-population abstraction, proprioception is an instantaneous sigmoid without stretch-receptor dynamics, mechanics are linear, and only the first and third instar literature comparators exist rather than a controlled experimental comparator in the same study. The authors state the model does not incorporate GVLIs, PMSI details, long-range inter-segmental connections or sophisticated fitting. The model reproduces the Inada et al. arrest/resumption but contradicts the Kohsaka et al. observation of a new wave from the posterior end, and it does not explain the up-to-10 s memory. No nociception, no noxious stimulus, no subjective pain, no human ECAP or SCS outcome, and no fly-to-human transfer is measured, modelled or claimed. Numerical integration details depend on a small artificial inertia term; code is described as MATLAB but no public repository or DOI is stated in the checked text, so no runtime reproduction was performed here.

No nociception, no noxious stimulus, no subjective pain, no human ECAP or SCS outcome, and no fly-to-human transfer is measured, modelled or claimed. Numerical integration details depend on a small artificial inertia term; code is described as MATLAB but no public repository or DOI is stated in the checked text, so no runtime reproduction was performed here.

sources.название: FLYNN: Robust Neural Network for Robot Navigation using Fly Brain Topology
sources.авторы: Benquan Wang; Jingdao Chen
sources.издание: arXiv preprint arXiv:2607.00025v2 (cs.RO); v1 posted 21 June 2026, v2 posted 13 July 2026; no journal reference yet
sources.модальность: Synaptic-resolution FAFB v783 Drosophila connectome used as the fixed sparse RNN connectivity, plus simulated stereo camera images, MLP-encoded target angle and collision signals, simulated wheel commands and episode outcomes in MuJoCo; no live fly or human recording.
sources.задача: Train a recurrent network whose connectivity is taken from the fly connectome to perform vision-based robot navigation in MuJoCo, and test out-of-distribution texture shift and camera-loss robustness without retraining.
sources.метод: FLYNN is an RNN whose sparse weight matrix is the FAFB v783 FlyWire edge list thresholded at >=5 synapses (139,255 neurons, 5,342,445 connections, 99.9725% topological sparsity), with one hidden state vector per time step, per-neuron-class leak rates, weights and biases all trainable. Visual input bypasses photoreceptors (incomplete data) and is mapped onto L1/L2/L3 neurons with manual temporal filtering/averaging; target angle is encoded by a small MLP into Johnston's-organ neurons; left/right collisions activate head bristle neurons; an MLP reads descending neurons out into differential wheel commands. Trained by DAgger imitation learning against a VFH* expert plus PID controller. Baselines: EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNet-v3-large (both with camera-dropout training) and a Watts-Strogatz SmallWorldNet matched on node count, degree, small-world property and sensory-to-descending path lengths.
sources.датасет: No experimental dataset and no new animals. Input resource is the released FlyWire FAFB v783 adult-female Drosophila connectome (139,255 neurons; 5,342,445 connections of >=5 synapses, from a single reconstructed brain). Training data are self-generated MuJoCo episodes: 4 DAgger iterations x 500 episodes (300 training steps per iteration, 128 batches per step), evaluation on 300 randomised episodes in a 14 x 14 m arena with 20 randomised cylindrical obstacles and 128 x 128 stereo cameras; OOD evaluation swaps checkerboard textures for photo-realistic ones without changing geometry or task.
sources.производительность: Table I, n=300 episodes per condition. Checkerboard full vision: FLYNN 92.9% success / SPL 0.83; MobileNet 91.6 / 0.81; EfficientNet 90.3 / 0.80; SmallWorldNet 89.0 / 0.80. Realistic-texture OOD (never seen in training): FLYNN 42.1 / 0.32; EfficientNet 17.2 / 0.15; SmallWorldNet 3.2 / 0.02; MobileNet 0.0 / 0.0. Single-eye loss: FLYNN 77.4 (left eye) and 69.6 (right eye); total blindness: FLYNN 44.3 / 0.37 versus MobileNet 16.5 / 0.16, EfficientNet 3.9 / 0.03, SmallWorldNet 2.6 / 0.02. FLYNN showed the highest collision counts (attributed by the authors to retained collision-recovery behaviour). PCA/KDE of internal states: first 10 components explain 89.1% of variance for FLYNN and 94.6% for SmallWorldNet; blind-to-full-vision vector superposition |BF|=11.16 versus |BL+BR|=11.11, cosine 0.9998 for FLYNN, 22.88 versus 30.01, cosine 0.9439 for SmallWorldNet. One training run per model; per-condition seed spread or confidence intervals are not reported, and SPL standard deviation is deliberately omitted as bimodal.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: simulation-only navigation benchmark over randomised episodes; no held-out fly, animal or human participant prediction
sources.ограничения: Simulation-only and methodological: a MuJoCo differential-drive robot, explicitly no validation on a physical robot. No nociception, noxious stimulus, subjective pain, pain-related behaviour, human ECAP or SCS outcome is measured, claimed or transferable; this is a connectome-topology navigation baseline, not a pain or welfare study. The connectome is the female adult FAFB v783 (FlyWire) reconstruction of one animal, used only as topology thresholded at >=5 synapses; spiking dynamics, electrical synapses/gap junctions, neurotransmitter types, axon-length differences, plasticity and neuromodulation are omitted. Roughly half of left-eye photoreceptor connectivity was missing, so photoreceptors were bypassed and the L1/L2 temporal filtering that aids OOD robustness was hand-implemented, which the authors name as a partial confound. The claimed OOD robustness covers visual texture shift only: arena geometry, obstacle statistics, task and dynamics are unchanged, and dynamics/sensor-noise shifts remain unevaluated. The PCA/KDE modularity explanation is explicitly correlational, not causal, and no mechanistic ablation of topology is performed. Baseline comparison is at a similar (~5M) parameter budget but each model was trained once; no seeds, no statistical tests. Code is linked at github.com/ben-gitdev/fly-gym but was not executed or reviewed here.

метод.value: FLYNN is an RNN whose sparse weight matrix is the FAFB v783 FlyWire edge list thresholded at >=5 synapses (139,255 neurons, 5,342,445 connections, 99.9725% topological sparsity), with one hidden state vector per time step, per-neuron-class leak rates, weights and biases all trainable. Visual input bypasses photoreceptors (incomplete data) and is mapped onto L1/L2/L3 neurons with manual temporal filtering/averaging; target angle is encoded by a small MLP into Johnston's-organ neurons; left/right collisions activate head bristle neurons; an MLP reads descending neurons out into differential wheel commands. Trained by DAgger imitation learning against a VFH* expert plus PID controller. Baselines: EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNet-v3-large (both with camera-dropout training) and a Watts-Strogatz SmallWorldNet matched on node count, degree, small-world property and sensory-to-descending path lengths.

ограничения.value: Simulation-only and methodological: a MuJoCo differential-drive robot, explicitly no validation on a physical robot. No nociception, noxious stimulus, subjective pain, pain-related behaviour, human ECAP or SCS outcome is measured, claimed or transferable; this is a connectome-topology navigation baseline, not a pain or welfare study. The connectome is the female adult FAFB v783 (FlyWire) reconstruction of one animal, used only as topology thresholded at >=5 synapses; spiking dynamics, electrical synapses/gap junctions, neurotransmitter types, axon-length differences, plasticity and neuromodulation are omitted. Roughly half of left-eye photoreceptor connectivity was missing, so photoreceptors were bypassed and the L1/L2 temporal filtering that aids OOD robustness was hand-implemented, which the authors name as a partial confound. The claimed OOD robustness covers visual texture shift only: arena geometry, obstacle statistics, task and dynamics are unchanged, and dynamics/sensor-noise shifts remain unevaluated. The PCA/KDE modularity explanation is explicitly correlational, not causal, and no mechanistic ablation of topology is performed. Baseline comparison is at a similar (~5M) parameter budget but each model was trained once; no seeds, no statistical tests. Code is linked at github.com/ben-gitdev/fly-gym but was not executed or reviewed here.

sources.название: Predicting visual function by interpreting a neuronal wiring diagram
sources.авторы: H. Sebastian Seung
sources.издание: Nature 634(8032):113-123; received 15 November 2023, accepted 15 August 2024, published online 2 October 2024 (version of record 2 October 2024, issue date 3 October 2024); DOI 10.1038/s41586-024-07953-5; PMID 39358524; PMC11446822
sources.модальность: Electron-microscopy connectome of the right optic lobe of one adult female Drosophila brain (FlyWire FAFB proofread reconstruction v783) analysed by graph mapping. No in-vivo neural recording, no stimulation experiment, no human data or human-derived signal in this study.
sources.задача: Interpret an already reconstructed neuronal wiring diagram to predict the visual function of Dm3 and TmY cell types in the Drosophila optic lobe (classical and extraclassical receptive fields, form/orientation vision).
sources.метод: Tm1 cells, in one-to-one correspondence with compound-eye hexels, are mapped onto a hexagonal lattice; average monosynaptic Tm1-Dm3 and Tm1-TmY input maps give predicted classical receptive fields (CRFs); disynaptic and trisynaptic pathways from Tm1 give predicted extraclassical receptive fields (pERFs); maps are approximated by ellipses and 1D projections to quantify orientation, aspect ratio and cell-to-cell variability; neurotransmitter and receptor identity are assigned from FlyWire electron-micrograph predictions and transcriptomic data. No dynamical simulation and no experiment were performed; the assumptions (monosynaptic CRF, non-paralleled polysynaptic ERF) are stated as testable by neurophysiology.
sources.датасет: FlyWire Codex FAFB proofread reconstruction v783, right optic lobe; cell-type annotations visual_neuron_types.csv.gz (6 May 2024), classification.csv.gz (6 March 2024), neurons.csv.gz (27 February 2024). Methods report hexagonal-lattice assignment for connections of 745 Tm1, 746 Tm2, 716 Tm9, 796 Mi1, 749 Mi4, 730 Mi9, 785 L1, 763 L2, 709 L3, 671 L4 and 774 L5 cells (deficit vs all proofread cells generally under 10%). Assignments of hexel types to lattice points and connectivity maps are released as Supplementary Data 2-4; code is published at https://github.com/hsseung/OpticLobe.jl (not executed here).
sources.производительность: No accuracy, AUROC, F1 or clinical metric is reported, because no prediction is compared with a new physiological measurement in this study. Quantitative results are geometric and statistical: the three Dm3 CRF maps align with the three cardinal orientations of the hexagonal lattice with little distributional overlap, median ellipse aspect ratio near 4, and stated cell-to-cell variability. The article explicitly frames the predictions as awaiting neurophysiological test, so this card carries no effect-size claim.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: one animal, one connectome; no held-out subject or cohort prediction is made
sources.ограничения: Single connectome of one adult female fly (FlyWire FAFB v783, right optic lobe), so no cross-animal or cross-subject replication exists and cell-to-cell variability is not separated into biological and technical parts. All "receptive fields" are predictions derived from connectivity, not measurements: the paper states that testing them requires neurophysiology, that the monosynaptic-CRF assumption is more certain for inhibitory than for excitatory polysynaptic pathways, and that an unexpected CRF length would invalidate the predicted facilitating ERF. Excitatory/inhibitory sign is inferred (Dm3 presumed inhibitory via GluClalpha, TmY4/TmY9 presumed excitatory) and Dm3v lacks transcriptomic data; TmY4/TmY9 GluClalpha expression is cited as unpublished personal communication. Connections are not thresholded, and synapse detection/proofreading carry residual error. Explicit limits: no nociception or noxious-stimulus construct, no protective behaviour, no ECAP/SCS or spinal-cord stimulation, no human participants, no clinical or treatment outcome, no animal-to-human transfer is tested or claimed. Species and version: Drosophila melanogaster, adult female; connectome version v783 of the proofread FAFB reconstruction as stated in Methods. Experimental comparator: none in this article (no new recording; comparison is to the same author's conceptual motifs and to published literature, and the article cites a separate bioRxiv preprint "Insights into vision from interpretation of a neuronal wiring diagram" (DOI 10.1101/2023.11.15.567126, v1 2023-11-15, v2 2023-11-16) with the same author and subject; the Nature article does not cite that preprint and no Crossref or author-declared version link was found, so preprint equivalence is unverified and only the Nature version of record is used for this card). No correction, retraction or author-correction notice was found on the Nature article page. Page-level full text was read through the Europe PMC author manuscript (PMC11446822), which the briefing's search_stream PA-01 route reached from forward citations in corpus cards S858 and S841.

No preprint equivalence with bioRxiv 10.1101/2023.11.15.567126 was established.

метод.value: Tm1 cells, in one-to-one correspondence with compound-eye hexels, are mapped onto a hexagonal lattice; average monosynaptic Tm1-Dm3 and Tm1-TmY input maps give predicted classical receptive fields (CRFs); disynaptic and trisynaptic pathways from Tm1 give predicted extraclassical receptive fields (pERFs); maps are approximated by ellipses and 1D projections to quantify orientation, aspect ratio and cell-to-cell variability; neurotransmitter and receptor identity are assigned from FlyWire electron-micrograph predictions and transcriptomic data. No dynamical simulation and no experiment were performed; the assumptions (monosynaptic CRF, non-paralleled polysynaptic ERF) are stated as testable by neurophysiology.

ограничения.value: Single connectome of one adult female fly (FlyWire FAFB v783, right optic lobe), so no cross-animal or cross-subject replication exists and cell-to-cell variability is not separated into biological and technical parts. All "receptive fields" are predictions derived from connectivity, not measurements: the paper states that testing them requires neurophysiology, that the monosynaptic-CRF assumption is more certain for inhibitory than for excitatory polysynaptic pathways, and that an unexpected CRF length would invalidate the predicted facilitating ERF. Excitatory/inhibitory sign is inferred (Dm3 presumed inhibitory via GluClalpha, TmY4/TmY9 presumed excitatory) and Dm3v lacks transcriptomic data; TmY4/TmY9 GluClalpha expression is cited as unpublished personal communication. Connections are not thresholded, and synapse detection/proofreading carry residual error. Explicit limits: no nociception or noxious-stimulus construct, no protective behaviour, no ECAP/SCS or spinal-cord stimulation, no human participants, no clinical or treatment outcome, no animal-to-human transfer is tested or claimed. Species and version: Drosophila melanogaster, adult female; connectome version v783 of the proofread FAFB reconstruction as stated in Methods. Experimental comparator: none in this article (no new recording; comparison is to the same author's conceptual motifs and to published literature, and the article cites a separate bioRxiv preprint "Insights into vision from interpretation of a neuronal wiring diagram" (DOI 10.1101/2023.11.15.567126, v1 2023-11-15, v2 2023-11-16) with the same author and subject; the Nature article does not cite that preprint and no Crossref or author-declared version link was found, so preprint equivalence is unverified and only the Nature version of record is used for this card). No correction, retraction or author-correction notice was found on the Nature article page. Page-level full text was read through the Europe PMC author manuscript (PMC11446822), which the briefing's search_stream PA-01 route reached from forward citations in corpus cards S858 and S841.

sources.название: Accelerating with FlyBrainLab the discovery of the functional logic of the Drosophila brain
sources.авторы: Aurel A. Lazar; Tingkai Liu; Mehmet Kerem Turkcan; Yiyin Zhou
sources.издание: eLife 10:e62362; version of record published 22 February 2021; DOI 10.7554/eLife.62362
sources.модальность: Adult and larval Drosophila connectome/synaptome datasets loaded into NeuroArch and executed as circuit models in Neurokernel, with 3D visualisation and English-query navigation in NeuroMynerva; a platform paper, with no new in-vivo recordings.
sources.задача: Build an open-source computing platform (FlyBrainLab) that integrates Drosophila neuroanatomical, neurogenetic and electrophysiological datasets with executable brain-circuit models, so that circuit function can be interactively explored, compared and evaluated.
sources.метод: NeuroMynerva JupyterLab user interface with NeuroNLP 3D/English-query navigation, the NeuroArch graph database, the Neurokernel GPU execution engine, plus Utilities Libraries for molecular transduction and Circuit Libraries; six use cases demonstrate circuit construction, querying and model comparison.
sources.датасет: Publicly loaded datasets: FlyCircuit version 1.2 (22,828 female fly neurons, 4,538,280 connections inferred after Huang et al., 2018), Hemibrain release 1.2 (25,842 neurons, 3,817,700 connections, 15,337,617 synapse positions), Medulla 7-column and Larva L1EM. These are pooled multi-animal and EM datasets, not one complete brain, and the paper pins them only by release name.
sources.производительность: Software-platform report: no predictive accuracy, AUC, effect size or clinical metric is reported. The authors document dataset load sizes and interface/execution demonstrations across six use cases.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no subject-level prediction or held-out cohort evaluation; the loaded connectomes are pooled datasets.
sources.ограничения: No nociception, noxious stimulus, pain construct or self-report is studied; the platform handles sensory coding of vision/olfaction. No ECAP, SCS outcome or clinical endpoint is measured, and no human participants are involved, so human transfer is neither shown nor implied. Drosophila only: adult Hemibrain 1.2 and FlyCircuit 1.2 plus larval L1EM; these are aggregate, multi-animal/EM datasets rather than one animal. No experimental comparator: the paper demonstrates the platform and libraries without prospective in-vivo validation of any modelled circuit. Connectome/synaptome versions are pinned only as release names, and platform code and datasets were not executed or downloaded here.

sources.название: Controlling neural stimulation using evoked compound action potential signals
sources.авторы: Marcelo Baru; February Meadows
sources.модальность: SCS ECAP waveforms, sub-threshold stimulation artifact time signatures and bench-test signals with an emulated ECAP input
sources.задача: Artifact removal and ECAP enhancement for closed-loop SCS control, and determination of a stimulation perception dose threshold
sources.метод: A calibration mode applies sub-threshold pulses (no ECAP) and stores the artifact time signature; a neurostimulating mode applies supra-threshold pulses and subtracts a scaled-up artifact copy whose scale factor equals the ratio of supra-threshold to sub-threshold current. Pseudo-tripolar sensing, ADC/DAC replay, delay alignment and a morphological filter extract ECAP morphology; an iterative SF-search declares the perception dose threshold DThr.
sources.датасет: No empirical patient cohort and no public dataset reported. Figures 5-7 signals were acquired during bench testing on an RC network load representative of the tissue-electrode interface with an emulated ECAP input signal.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_reported: patent disclosure, not an empirical evaluation
sources.ограничения: Patent claims and embodiments are prior art, not measured efficacy. No cohort, split, metric, calibration, uncertainty or independent validation is disclosed, and the bench test uses an emulated ECAP signal on an RC load. ECAP is claimed (claims 1-14): sensed in both modes and used as the control signal. Simulation or a physiological model is not claimed as a method element, optimisation is not claimed as a learning/search method, and no human outcome, Drosophila or connectome element appears anywhere in the disclosure.

evidence.population: No empirical cohort reported; bench-test signals only

sources.название: System for patient and adaptive therapy modeling and simulation
sources.авторы: Leonid M. Litvak; Scott R. Stanslaski; Pearl K. Yamaguchi; Ankita S. Patel; Kirk W. Finnis; Christian H. De Laslo
sources.издание: Google Patents / WIPO PCT publication WO2026087974A1
sources.модальность: Simulated electrical stimulation signals, virtual patient model outputs, alpha-beta local field potential, dyskinesia/bradykinesia indications and simulated side effects
sources.задача: Clinician-facing simulation of adaptive (open-loop or closed-loop) neurostimulation therapy on a virtual patient model, so that programs and settings can be explored without a live patient
sources.метод: A first model representing a patient and a second model representing a stimulation device interact inside a simulation scenario; simulated signals pass through processing components (virtual basal ganglia, simulated motor processing unit, pathologic activation engine, simulated nearby structures) that emit simulated responses, alpha-beta LFP and side-effect indications, with switchable open-loop/closed-loop configuration and simulated medication, activity and elapsed-time effects (claims 1-15; Examples 1-37).
sources.кросс_субъект: not_reported: patent disclosure contains no empirical cross-subject evaluation
sources.ограничения: Patent disclosure is prior art and a claimed simulation design, not measured efficacy: no cohort, dataset, split, metric, calibration or clinical outcome is reported, and the virtual patient, LFP and symptom outputs are simulated rather than observed. ECAP appears only in description paragraph [0083] and is not recited in any rendered claim; claims 1-15 instead cover the patient-model/stimulation-device simulation system, the alpha-beta LFP output, dyskinesia/bradykinesia/side-effect outputs, open-loop/closed-loop switching and server or user-device delivery, while explicit therapy-parameter optimisation is not claimed (only user adjustment of operating parameters in claim 11 and open-loop/closed-loop switching in claim 7). No Drosophila, connectome, nociceptive or human-outcome link is claimed or described. The stated total of 25 claims could not be confirmed: the checked page renders claim text only for claims 1-15 and the remaining claim text is truncated in the source.

validation.notes: Google Patents record for WO2026087974A1 checked on 2026-09-30 (direct page returned 503; the rendered record was read through the r.jina.ai proxy and cross-checked against the Patsnap publication view). Bibliographic data, description and the rendered claims 1-15 agree with the assignment brief. Claim 1 discloses the patient model plus stimulator model simulation system; claims 3 and 5 disclose dyskinesia/bradykinesia/side-effect outputs and the alpha-beta LFP. Patent disclosure is prior art, not empirical validation.

sources.название: Functional Characterization of Individual Pre- and Postsynaptic Partners In the Drosophila Larval Central Nervous System Using CaMPARI
sources.авторы: Claudia Gualtieri; Fernando J. Vonhoff
sources.модальность: neural_activity, connectome
sources.задача: Functional characterization of larval nociceptive-network partners
sources.метод: In intact third-instar Drosophila larvae, CsChrimson optogenetically activates cIVda nociceptors while CaMPARI photoconversion in Basin-4 interneurons reports postsynaptic calcium; fluorescence ROIs were defined in Fiji.
sources.датасет: Figure 2E plots per-larva mean delta red/green CaMPARI fluorescence for 8 controls and 9 stimulated larvae; the inspected manuscript/repository item does not supply the underlying per-larva numerical series.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_reported
sources.ограничения: The full author manuscript supports a functional cIVda-to-Basin-4 calcium-signaling assay in intact larvae, with Figure 2E reporting 8 control and 9 experimental larvae and a qualitative significant delta(R/G) increase. Exact plotted numerical values, p-value, raw per-larva series, independent replication and a fitted whole-connectome dynamical model are not established here. It does not measure subjective pain, human ECAP, SCS response, or cross-species transfer.

evidence.population: Figure 2E reports 17 third-instar larval observations: 8 no-ATR controls (23 analyzed cells) and 9 stimulated larvae (19 analyzed cells); the plotted unit is each larva averaged over 1-4 cells.
evidence.target_label: CaMPARI photoconversion as functional synaptic-signaling readout

validation.notes: Official UMBC/MD-SOAR author manuscript of DOI 10.3791/71399 checked 2026-10-01. Figure 2E: 8 control larvae/23 cells and 9 experimental larvae/19 cells, per-larva averaged delta(R/G), author-reported significant increase without an exact p-value in the caption. References 1-40 available in the manuscript and bibliographic identities checked against PubMed. The full JoVE page remains robot-gated; institutional manuscript is the inspected full text.

sources.название: From the fly connectome to exact ring attractor dynamics
sources.авторы: Tirthabir Biswas; Angel Stanoev; Sandro Romani; James E. Fitzgerald
sources.модальность: Two-photon calcium imaging of EPG neural activity in vivo, paired with computational ring-attractor modeling constrained by fly connectomes.
sources.задача: Test whether connectome-constrained head-direction ring-attractor models reproduce EPG activity profiles measured in this study in adult female Drosophila.
sources.метод: Threshold-linear recurrent network analysis of four EPG-Delta7 connectomes, combined with two-photon jGCaMP7f calcium imaging of EPG neurons in 6-8-day-old female flies and nonlinear least-squares fitting of modeled bump amplitude and position to measured DeltaF/F0 profiles.
sources.датасет: Four Drosophila central-complex connectomes (Male CNS, hemibrain, flywire-fafb, BANC) plus in-vivo EPG calcium-imaging data from 6-8-day-old female UAS-jGCaMP7f;SS00096-GAL4 flies. The number of imaged flies is not stated in the checked primary text.
sources.производительность: Not a supervised prediction benchmark. The paper reports three connectome-constrained model realizations and fits their EPG activity profiles to calcium-imaging profiles recorded in this study; the models use shape parameters r_a=0.548, 0.437, and 0.391 for A_Delta=8, 6, and 4. No total fly count or held-out-animal test result is reported.
sources.кросс_субъект: No participant-level or held-out-animal prediction evaluation is reported. The authors fit modeled profiles to EPG imaging data collected in the study; the number of imaged flies is not stated in the checked primary text.
sources.ограничения: The paper combines computational Drosophila head-direction modeling with two-photon calcium imaging of EPG neurons in 6-8-day-old female flies. The number of imaged flies is not reported in the checked primary text and is left unspecified. The experiments concern EPG neural activity and head direction; they do not measure nociception, protective behavior, subjective pain, ECAP, SCS response, human outcomes, or a clinical chain.

sources.название: Nociception and hypersensitivity involve distinct neurons and molecular transducers in Drosophila
sources.авторы: Pengyu Gu; Fei Wang; Ye Shang; Jingjing Liu; Jiaxin Gong; Wei Xie; Junhai Han; Yang Xiang
sources.издание: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America, 119(12), e2113645119 (published online 2022-03-16; issue date 2022-03-22)
sources.модальность: Thermal stimulus and nocifensive rolling behavior; genetic perturbation; larval-brain calcium imaging
sources.задача: Dissect whether acute heat nociception and tissue-injury-induced heat hypersensitivity in Drosophila larvae use the same neurons and molecular transducers.
sources.метод: Third-instar larval heat-probe rolling assays; brief UVC epidermal injury to induce hypersensitivity; TrpA1 isoform knockout/knockin and tissue-specific RNAi/perturbation; optogenetic and thermogenetic activation; GCaMP calcium imaging of larval CNS neurons; pharmacologic PLC manipulation.
sources.датасет: Primary experimental data reported in the article; no separate reusable dataset identifier found in the checked article record.
sources.производительность: Acute heat nociception required TrpA1-D in peripheral C4da sensory neurons, whereas UVC injury-induced heat allodynia required TrpA1-C in larval brain BLA neurons; BLA synaptic transmission and Tachykinin receptor/Gq/PLC signaling were implicated in injury-induced heat responses. The paper reports behavioral and calcium-imaging experiments, not a predictive model benchmark.
sources.кросс_субъект: Not a human or cross-subject prediction study; experiments compare Drosophila larval genotypes and perturbations.
sources.ограничения: Drosophila larval mechanistic study of heat-evoked nocifensive rolling and injury-induced hypersensitivity. Rolling is a nociceptive/protective behavioral readout, not evidence of subjective pain. Does not assess human pain, clinical outcomes, ECAP, SCS, or transfer between species. Exact per-condition sample counts are referred to as bracketed values in figure legends but are not stated numerically in the checked machine-readable article text; sample_size therefore remains null.

sources.название: A Clinical Feasibility Study of Spinal Evoked Compound Action Potential Estimation Methods.
sources.авторы: Chakravarthy K, FitzGerald J, Will A, Trutnau K, Corey R, Dinsmoor D, Litvak L.
sources.модальность: Human spinal ECAP and associated stimulation-artifact recordings.
sources.задача: Compare four approaches for estimating spinal evoked compound action potentials from human clinical recordings; signal-estimation feasibility work, not an SCS pain-efficacy study.
sources.метод: A library of 112 ECAP and associated artifact recordings from 14 human subjects was processed using high-pass filtering (HP), artifact-model subtraction (AM), triangularly weighted sinusoid-template correlation, and the standard P2-N1 amplitude measure. ECAP growth-curve slopes S_resp and S_art were calculated; the abstract reports comparison by |S_resp/S_art|.
sources.датасет: 112 ECAP and associated artifact recordings from 14 human subjects; individual recording counts by subject are not reported in the abstract.
sources.производительность: All artifact-reduction schemes could under- or over-estimate neural activation or misclassify stimulation artifact as ECAP. The |S_resp/S_art| ratio was superior (p < 0.05) for HP and AM relative to template correlation and P2-N1. This is a signal-estimation metric, not pain or treatment-response performance.
sources.ограничения: Abstract-level evidence only: the article full text is subscription-only. Per-subject recording counts, exact statistics beyond the abstract, split or independent external validation, and cohort independence from S787 remain unresolved. No analgesia, pain-intensity, responder, or other clinical-efficacy endpoint is reported; no fly/Drosophila or synthetic-ECAP component is reported.

sources.название: In-Clinic and At-Home Patient Experiences with Closed-Loop Spinal Cord Stimulation: 12-Month Outcomes from the Closed-Loop Australia Randomized Crossover Trial
sources.авторы: Vahid Mohabbati; Richard Sullivan; James Yu; Peter Georgius; Charles D. Brooker; Malgorzata Siorek; Bonnie Ditterline; Jessica K. Friedman; Marc A. Russo
sources.модальность: ECAP-controlled closed-loop spinal cord stimulation with patient-reported in-clinic overstimulation ratings and secondary VAS pain outcomes
sources.задача: Report 12-month patient-reported overstimulation during randomized in-clinic closed-loop versus open-loop crossover tests, alongside secondary at-home experience and longitudinal pain outcomes.
sources.метод: Multisite prospective single-arm feasibility study; randomized, blinded within-participant in-clinic crossover sequence of CL-SCS and OL-SCS during participant-selected movements. Primary endpoint is overstimulation experience. Long-term treatment allocation and VAS pain follow-up are not randomized between groups. Twelve-month analyses are exploratory and not explicitly powered.
sources.датасет: Closed-Loop Australia study NCT05177354: 94 adults enrolled; 55 reached the 1-month primary endpoint; 46 had baseline and 12-month data for this analysis. Article and ClinicalTrials.gov provide aggregate outcomes; participant-level data are not publicly available to protect intellectual property.
sources.производительность: At 12 months, in-clinic overstimulation median score was 0.4 (IQR 0-1.0) with CL-SCS versus 3.0 (IQR 2.6-4.0) with OL-SCS; paired Wilcoxon p<0.001, r=0.86. Separately, exploratory descriptive secondary follow-up reported median VAS pain reduction of 60 mm from baseline and at least 50% pain relief in 36/46 (78%) at 12 months. The VAS change is not a randomized between-treatment contrast and does not establish causal pain efficacy of closed-loop control.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: clinical within-participant crossover and follow-up; no predictive model or cross-subject validation
sources.ограничения: Single-arm feasibility study with randomized in-clinic test sequence only; randomization does not assign long-term closed-loop versus open-loop treatment. Twelve-month VAS outcomes are secondary, descriptive/exploratory, not explicitly powered, and lack a randomized long-term comparator; no causal pain-efficacy inference is supported. Attrition left 46 participants with baseline and 12-month data. Participant-level datasets are not publicly available (intellectual-property protection); aggregate endpoints are posted at NCT05177354. ECAP is stimulation feedback, not a direct pain measure. Study sponsored by Medtronic. S903 and S826 (DOI 10.1093/pm/pnaf058) report the same NCT05177354 cohort; S826 is the earlier 3-month report, so S903 is not an independent cohort.

evidence.population: Adults with chronic back, leg, and/or upper-limb pain and baseline VAS >=60 mm enrolled in the Closed-Loop Australia study; implantation and long-term follow-up followed successful device trial.
evidence.sample_size: 94 enrolled; 55 at 1-month primary endpoint; 46 with baseline and 12-month data in this report.
evidence.target_label: Primary: patient-rated in-clinic overstimulation severity (0-4) during within-participant randomized CL-SCS versus OL-SCS movement tests. Secondary, distinct outcome: self-reported VAS pain intensity during uncontrolled longitudinal follow-up.

validation.notes: Springer version of record full text checked, including Methods (Data and Study Design, Measures, Analysis), Results, Limitations, and Data Availability. The trial is prospective and single-arm; randomization applies to blinded in-clinic crossover test order, not long-term pain treatment allocation. The primary endpoint is overstimulation experience. VAS pain is a distinct secondary exploratory longitudinal outcome; no causal pain-efficacy inference is made. Individual analyzed datasets are not public; aggregate endpoints are posted to NCT05177354. This is a later report from the same study cohort as S826 (DOI 10.1093/pm/pnaf058), not an independent cohort.

sources.модальность: connectome, neural_activity, simulation_state, behavior
sources.задача: Closed-loop connectome-constrained brain-body-environment simulation of C. elegans locomotion
sources.метод: BAAIWorm couples a 136-neuron biophysically detailed C. elegans foraging circuit, whose connection weights/polarities are optimized to match experimental neural activity patterns, to a 3D soft-body/fluid environment. Simulated neural states control muscles and sensory input depends on virtual food concentration; synthetic structural perturbations probe effects on model dynamics and behavior.
sources.датасет: C. elegans: 136 modeled sensory/locomotion neurons; experimental neural-activity correlation target comprises 65 identified neurons; 3D body model with 96 muscles and virtual food/environment.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable
sources.ограничения: This is a C. elegans foraging/locomotion simulation, not Drosophila nociception or protective behavior. Validation tunes model weights to reproduce an experimental 65-neuron activity correlation matrix and compares simulated food-seeking trajectories with observed worm behavior; synthetic perturbations are in silico. No human pain data, ECAP observation operator, SCS intervention, clinical outcomes, or cross-species transfer are studied.

validation.notes: Primary Nature full text checked. Model contains 136 neurons; model tuning targets a correlation matrix of 65 identified neurons (Results, “A data-driven biophysically detailed neural network model”). BAAIWorm uses closed-loop brain/body/environment interaction for simulated food-seeking locomotion and synthetic structural perturbations (Abstract; Results 2.1 and “Replicating locomotion behavior”). Trajectory similarity and neural correlation structure are model validation; they do not establish biological fidelity, nociception, cross-species transfer or clinical prediction.

sources.название: Labeling of active neural circuits in vivo with designed calcium integrators
sources.авторы: Benjamin F. Fosque; Yi Sun; Hod Dana; Chao-Tsung Yang; Tomoko Ohyama; Michael R. Tadross; Ronak Patel; Marta Zlatic; Douglas S. Kim; Misha B. Ahrens; Vivek Jayaraman; Loren L. Looger; Eric R. Schreiter
sources.модальность: Method for permanent, time-restricted activity labeling with the genetically encoded calcium integrator CaMPARI.
sources.задача: Develop and validate CaMPARI for post hoc labeling of active neural populations in vivo.
sources.метод: PubMed abstract states CaMPARI undergoes irreversible green-to-red conversion only when elevated intracellular calcium coincides with experimenter-controlled illumination; utility demonstrated in freely moving zebrafish and fly larvae, and in head-fixed mice and adult flies.
sources.датасет: Abstract-level method demonstrations in zebrafish, Drosophila, and mice; full text was inaccessible during this review.
sources.ограничения: Only PubMed bibliographic metadata and abstract were accessible; the Science full-text route returned HTTP 403 and no PMC/open copy was found. sources.название: How much of fly walking is written in the wiring?
sources.авторы: Isabel Guan; Yuntian Zhao; Dingyuan Zhang; Shipeng Lyu; I-Ming Chen
sources.модальность: connectome, simulation_state
sources.задача: Test which fly leg-motor outputs depend on the specific ventral nerve cord wiring rather than generic graph statistics.
sources.метод: Fixed-synapse-weight rate models of two adult male VNC connectomes, six families of rewired network controls, prespecified antagonist-coordination criteria and fresh-noise confirmation runs.
sources.датасет: MaleCNS v1.0 and MANC v1.0 connectome leg-motor subnetworks (10,173 and 10,440 model neurons); source data attached to the preprint.
sources.производительность: Author-reported primary-window antagonist score S=0.312 for MaleCNS versus at most 0.144 for the rewired networks, and S=0.173 for MANC versus at most 0.084. Rhythmicity itself was often achieved by rewired networks; these are model outputs, not observed animal performance.
sources.кросс_субъект: Two independently reconstructed male adult fly connectomes were compared; no held-out animal/clinical evaluation.
sources.ограничения: The outputs concern a rate-model leg-motor circuit and antagonist coordination, not nociception, human ECAP or SCS. Glutamatergic transmission was assumed inhibitory; results are model-only, with no body or sensory feedback and no recording-based test of predicted phase relationships. MANC effects are weaker than MaleCNS. Preprint, not a peer-reviewed journal result.

validation.notes.value: Official arXiv v1 HTML and abstract checked. Figure 1/Results specify two VNC connectomes, 20 antagonist pool pairs per connectome and graph-preserving null families. Figure 2 reports simulated coordination and rhythm separately. Methods report 20 fresh-noise runs for confirmation; these runs are not independent animals. Discussion explicitly says conclusions concern the model, not the animal, and predicted phase relationships remain to be compared with walking-fly recordings. No nociception, human ECAP, SCS or clinical outcome is demonstrated. The arXiv page labels DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2609.38665 as pending registration; it is not stored as a confirmed DOI.

sources.название: Feedback inhibition by a descending GABAergic neuron regulates timing of escape behavior in Drosophila larvae
sources.авторы: Jiayi Zhu; Jean-Christophe Boivin; Alastair Garner; Jing Ning; Yi Q Zhao; Tomoko Ohyama
sources.модальность: connectome, neural_activity, behavior
sources.задача: Explain the timing of larval Drosophila rolling and the transition to escape crawling after nociceptive-pathway activation.
sources.метод: Published larval circuit connectivity was combined with optogenetic gain/loss perturbations, thermal/behavior assays, immunostaining and two-photon calcium imaging to test SeIN128/Basin-2/A00c inhibitory feedback.
sources.датасет: Third-instar Drosophila larval circuit experiments and previously reconstructed Basin/A00c/SeIN128 connectivity; experiment-specific denominators appear in figures, with no one pooled larva count.
sources.производительность: The paper reports that SeIN128 inhibition prolongs rolling and delays the transition to escape crawling; calcium, anatomical and behavioral results support a feedback-inhibition mechanism. These are circuit/behavior results, not a predictive benchmark or pain-intensity metric.
sources.кросс_субъект: Experimental larvae are used in separate perturbation and imaging groups; no cross-animal predictive train/test split or human validation.
sources.ограничения: The study observes nociceptive escape behavior and circuit activity in Drosophila larvae. It does not train a connectome-constrained dynamics model, report subjective pain, human ECAP/SCS, or clinical treatment response. Circuit reconstruction cited in the study predates this experiment; figure-specific Ns must not be pooled.

validation.notes: eLife VOR full-text XML checked through Europe PMC PMCID PMC11357356. Abstract and Results s2-4/s2-6 support existing-connectome/functional connectivity, SeIN128 feedback and perturbation of rolling. Methods s4-4, s4-8 describe behavior and two-photon imaging of third-instar larvae. No global N is inferred from panel-specific Ns. The paper studies observed nociceptive escape behavior, not subjective pain, a trained connectome-dynamics model, ECAP or SCS.
